2 year warranty - easy installation - low cost maintenance

Power:

  • 30kW – 500kW
  • For more power and specific projects, please contact us

Capacity:

  • 25.800kcal/h–430.000 kcal/h

Working pressure:

  • Atmospheric pressure

Voltage:

  • 400V III 50Hz/60Hz

Resistance:

  • Inox 321
  • With insulation of powdered magnesium

Integrated electric control panel:

  • Fractional power: Three stages in all grades
  • All stages with their own electrical protection
  • Linear sequence grade control
  • Forced air circulation within the control panel

Temperature control:

  • Electronic thermometer/thermostat with data reading

Security systems:

  • Pressure safety valve
  • Temperature cut-out

Pilot lights:

  • General status signal unit (On-Off)
  • Activated grades
  • Security status in all grades
  • Number of activated stages

Tank:

  • In steel/carbon
  • Insulation of kaolin wool

Accesories:

  • Supply meter (kw/h)

Outside finish:

  • Assembled on a tubular chassis and covered with a sheet of wood and paint furnace finished Epoxi

Certificates:

  • CE Pressure Vessels
  • CE Low Voltage
  • CE Electromagnetic Compatibility

Transmission:

  • Copper sealing protected with methacrylate
  • Circuit cut-out breaker in main plug

item.title: Heating Storage Equipment
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
HEATING STORAGE EQUIPMENT

REQUEST A QUOTE

Technology to ensure hot service and long life without breakdowns.

La acumulación de calor para dar servicio de calefacción, agua caliente para duchas o en procesos industriales es una tecnología desarrollada por los técnicos de ete, se fabrican desde los años 80, hay cientos de instalaciones que funcionan a pleno rendimiento sin averías con un rendimiento del 100%.

Los equipos de acumulación de calor ete consumen kwh a precios reducidos en las horas que se pacte con las compañías eléctricas, generando ahorros superiores al 50% respecto a cualquier energía, permite reducir la potencia eléctrica contratada.

El calor se acumula y se utiliza posteriormente en las horas que se necesite producir calefacción, agua caliente en duchas o procesos industriales.

Los materiales de construcción junto con su tecnología permiten dar una garantía de 10 años y asegurar el servicio durante toda la vida de equipo.

Díganos las necesidades de su instalación, los técnicos de ete calcularán la potencia del equipo garantizando el servicio por escrito.

Determine the minimum winter outdoor temperature in your area, look at the outdoor temperature column: -5ºC; -3ºC; 0ºC and + 5ºC.

Once in the column you have selected, find the square meters of your home.

Once located in the square meters of your home, scroll to the left and you will see the power you need and the heat production equipment, there are two columns, one for heating equipment and the other for heating equipment and sanitary hot water for bathrooms and kitchen.

Do not be surprised if the power shown in the table does not match the power of your combustion boiler or your old electric boiler, it is normal for our equipment to have a much lower power.

As you can see, the powers of 4.5kw and 7.5kw can be supplied to connect to 230V II or 400VIII, depending on the electrical installation you have, the rest of the powers connect to 400VIII, which is a normal voltage in large homes.

Exchanging the old boiler for high-tech ete brand because it is common when calculating electric boilers of other brands to install 30 kW electric boilers to heat the same surface.

Ete electric boilers can replace any type of electric or combustion boiler, the replacement can be done by any plumber with the support of the electrician who installs the power supply cable.

When you consult the ete technicians, they will provide you in writing with all the information you need to make a safe boiler change decision with a 2-year warranty.

2 year warranty - easy installation - low cost maintenance

La tecnológica de los equipos que fabrica ete para producir agua caliente para hoteles, hospitales, instalaciones deportivas, peluquerías, centros de yoga, industrias, comunidades de vecinos o cualquier proceso que tenga un gran consumo, tiene como fin garantizar el servicio de agua caliente y optimizar el coste energético.

Los técnicos de ete hacen un estudio integral de las necesidades del cliente, recomiendan el equipo garantizando por escrito el servicio, el consumo en kwh y en euros y la instalación que garantice el servicio de agua caliente.

Nuestra tecnología nos permite implantar equipos de menor volumen y potencia, beneficiando a nuestros clientes con el ahorro en compra de equipo y energía.

Los materiales que se utilizan en los equipos ete de agua caliente sanitaria permiten dar una garantía de 5 años aunque la vida será superior a los 20 años.

Díganos las necesidades de su instalación, los técnicos de ete calcularán la potencia de la caldera garantizando el servicio por escrito.

La tecnológica de los equipos que fabrica ete para producir agua caliente para hoteles, hospitales, instalaciones deportivas, peluquerías, centros de yoga, industrias, comunidades de vecinos o cualquier proceso que tenga un gran consumo, tiene como fin garantizar el servicio de agua caliente y optimizar el coste energético.

Los técnicos de ete hacen un estudio integral de las necesidades del cliente, recomiendan el equipo garantizando por escrito el servicio, el consumo en kwh y en euros y la instalación que garantice el servicio de agua caliente.

Nuestra tecnología nos permite implantar equipos de menor volumen y potencia, beneficiando a nuestros clientes con el ahorro en compra de equipo y energía.

Los materiales que se utilizan en los equipos ete de agua caliente sanitaria permiten dar una garantía de 5 años aunque la vida será superior a los 20 años.

Díganos las necesidades de su instalación, los técnicos de ete calcularán la potencia de la caldera garantizando el servicio por escrito.

item.content:encoded:
HEATING AND HOT WATER FOR HOMES

REQUEST A QUOTE

How much cost to heat your home?

Table to calculate the power and equipment to provide heating service, depending on the square meters and the minimum outdoor temperatures, with ete technology to produce heat, using electricity:
Model Power Square meters of a home, building, comercial office, ceiling height of 2,60m - according to minimum outdoor temperatures

Determine the minimum winter outdoor temperature in your area, look at the outdoor temperature column: -5ºC; -3ºC; 0ºC and + 5ºC.

Once in the column you have selected, find the square meters of your home.

Once located in the square meters of your home, scroll to the left and you will see the power you need and the heat production equipment, there are two columns, one for heating equipment and the other for heating equipment and sanitary hot water for bathrooms and kitchen.

Do not be surprised if the power shown in the table does not match the power of your combustion boiler or your old electric boiler, it is normal for our equipment to have a much lower power.

As you can see, the powers of 4.5kw and 7.5kw can be supplied to connect to 230V II or 400VIII, depending on the electrical installation you have, the rest of the powers connect to 400VIII, which is a normal voltage in large homes.

Exchanging the old boiler for high-tech ete brand because it is common when calculating electric boilers of other brands to install 30 kW electric boilers to heat the same surface.

Ete electric boilers can replace any type of electric or combustion boiler, the replacement can be done by any plumber with the support of the electrician who installs the power supply cable.

When you consult the ete technicians, they will provide you in writing with all the information you need to make a safe boiler change decision with a 2-year warranty.

FAQs

Who is Thermic Electric Solutions? We have been manufacturing electric heating equipment since 1977. We manufacture water, superheated water, thermal oil, and steam for industry, bakery equipment, spa equipment, swimming pool equipment, sanitary water, heating, and Bikram Hot Yoga centers. You have a heat process, you want to improve it.
  • Provide us with the process data and our technicians will calculate the equipment’s power and temperature.
  • We guarantee the heating service you need in writing.
  • The goal is to save on your energy bill every month and prevent air pollution.
How are the power and consumption of a home's heating system calculated using ETE equipment?

Determine the square meters of the home and the minimum outdoor temperature.

Based on the minimum outdoor temperatures, the watts per square meter are determined. -5ºC 50W/m2, -3ºC 45W/m2, 0ºC 40W/m2, +5ºC 35W/m2.

Calculate the power of the ETE unit. For a 100m2 home and 0ºC minimum outdoor temperature, 100×40 = 4000W.

This calculation should only be applied to ETE technology; do not apply to other brands.

The unit is manufactured in two versions: heating only and heating and domestic hot water. For wall or floor mounting.

How is ETE different from its competitors?
  • Experience and technology are the values ​​that place ETE electrical equipment at the top of the market.
  • There are more than 20,000 units installed worldwide, for all types of heating processes, industry, and comfort.
  • Our competition sells equipment. Thermic Electric Solutions sells heating services, guaranteeing both heating service and energy consumption.
What is Thermic Electric Solutions' position on obsolescence? Since the company’s founding in 1977, the guiding principles of our operations have been ethical, respectful of the environment, and respect for the life of our equipment. It’s normal for our equipment for heating, bakeries, spas, hot yoga centers, and industrial processes to go more than 30 years without breakdowns or maintenance costs. Are ETE electric heating equipment prices competitive? Can we compare the price of an electric bicycle with that of an electric car? Both are useful for getting around, but the service they provide is different. The technology of ETE electric heating equipment cannot be compared with that manufactured by other companies, as they use very basic technology and are prone to breakdowns. ETE equipment is a proven and safe technology. Are spare parts for ETE electrical equipment expensive? Breakdowns rarely occur, so spare parts are not necessary. When designing our equipment, we use 90% of components available on the international market, and they are easy to purchase anywhere in the world. Upon request, we can recommend components we have in stock for emergency intervention. Can ETE heating equipment be installed with photovoltaic and wind panels?

Of course, our equipment, both industrial and residential, can be connected to photovoltaic and wind panels.

Our recommendation is to first purchase ETE equipment, install it, powered by the grid, and after a few months of consumption, send the utility bills to the solar panel supplier so they can provide you with a quote for the power needed for both industrial and residential use.

item.content:encoded:
HOT WATER 210°C

REQUEST A QUOTE

Technology to ensure hot service and long life without breakdowns.

High efficiency electric boilers with high technology to guarantee the service and a long life without failures.

The industrial electric boilers up to 210ºC by ete have the Technology used by the 21st century technician.

The design and components allow to give 2 years guarantee and to ensure the service during the long life of the industrial boiler.

Thinking about your safety, our solutions are electric.

Thinking about your economy, our exclusive technology allows you to install low power with guaranteed service.

Thinking about the environment, our electric water boilers are zero emissions.

2 year warranty - easy installation - low cost maintenance

Advantages of electric superheated water boilers by ete as an alternative to steam boilers:
  • Elimination of the condensate collection facility.
  • Elimination of corrosion problems.
  • Simplification of pipe networks and installation.
  • Simplification of control and regulation systems.
  • Minimum maintenance.
  • The installation is carried out with the same principles as water installations, taking into account when choosing materials, temperature and pressure.

Power:

  • 4,5kW – 1000kW
  • For more power and specific projects, please contact us

Capacity:

  • 3,870kcal/h – 860,000kcal/h

Working pressure:

  • – 6.0 kg/cm2

Voltage:

  • 400V III 50Hz/60Hz (optional: 230V III)

Resistance:

  • Shielded with a copper tube and powdered magnesium

Integrated electric control panel:

  • Precision (+/- 0.5C) and high performance
  • Fractional power. Three stages in all grades
  • All stages with their own electrical protection
  • Totally wired control panel
  • Linear sequence grade control
  • Forced air circulation within the control panel

Temperature control:

  • Electric control system and reading of grades
  • Precision of +/- 0,5ºC in water outlet

Security systems:

  • Temperature cut-out
  • Pressure relief valve
  • Pressure safety cut-out in case of lack of water

Pilot lights:

  • General status signal unit (On-Off)
  • Security status
  • Activated grades
  • Number of activated stages

Thermal insulation:

  • Rock wool

Accesories:

  • Supply meter (kw/h)
  • Outlet valve

Outside finish:

  • Assembled on a tubular chassis and covered with a sheet of wood and paint furnace finished Epoxi

Certificates:

  • CE Pressure Vessels
  • CE Low Voltage
  • CE Electromagnetic Compatibility

Transmission:

  • Copper sealing protected with methacrylate
  • Circuit cut-out breaker in main plug

Hot Water for hairdressing

REQUESTA A QUOTE

TECHNOLOGY TO GUARANTEE HEATING SERVICE AND A LONG LIFE WITHOUT BREAKDOWN.

The service of hot water to wash heads in the hairdressers is vital for the business to be profitable, on peak days of service there must be hot water to wash the head of each and every client, otherwise they will leave and will not return.

The equipment for hot water by ete is manufacture specifically for hairdressing salons, guarantees the number of washes per hour.

Hundreds of hairdressers have ete hot water equipment installed since the 80s with absolute service success and low energy consumption.

Installation is simple and requires little space.

The construction materials together with its technology allow us to give a 2-year guarantee and ensure service throughout the life of the equipment.

ELECTRIC BOILERS

REQUEST A QUOTE

TECHNOLOGY TO GUARANTEE HEATING SERVICE AND A LONG LIFE WITHOUT BREAKDOWNS.

Manufacturing bespoke industrial electric boilers since 1977, with the world's most advanced technology in manufacturing electrical equipment Joule effects for heat production.

Manufacturing custom industrial electric boilers since 1977, using the world's most advanced Joule-effect electric heating technology for industrial heat generation.

We manufacture high-power units:

  • Up to 2 MW for thermal fluid.
  • Up to 3 MW for water, superheated water, and steam.

For higher power requirements, multiple modules can be installed and combined to provide the total output needed by the process.

With our technology, we recommend installing smaller units directly at each point of consumption. This eliminates heat losses associated with extensive piping networks.

The dimensions and power ratings of our equipment are subject to transportation constraints from our manufacturing facility to the final destination.

FAQs

Who is Thermic Electric Solutions? We have been manufacturing electric heating equipment since 1977. We manufacture water, superheated water, thermal oil, and steam for industry, bakery equipment, spa equipment, swimming pool equipment, sanitary water, heating, and Bikram Hot Yoga centers. You have a heat process, you want to improve it.
  • Provide us with the process data and our technicians will calculate the equipment’s power and temperature.
  • We guarantee the heating service you need in writing.
  • The goal is to save on your energy bill every month and prevent air pollution.
How to calculate the power of heating equipment in industry? To calculate the power in both existing and new heat processes, the universal formula is applied. The combustion boiler power is not taken into account. Mass to be heated x thermal difference x specific heat x time = kilocalories. Example: heating 5,000 liters of vegetable oil from 20°C to 80°C in one hour. Specific heat of vegetable oil 0.40, thermal difference 60°C. The kW produces 860 kilocalories. 5,000 x 60 = 300,000. 300,000 x 0.40 = 120,000 kcal/h. The electrical power of the equipment is 120,000:860 = 139 kW. A 139 kW water treatment plant will be installed, operating at 110°C. Do you want to remove the combustion heating equipment and install an electric one? You provide us with the heating process data, and our technicians will calculate the power you need. This is typically 50 to 70% less than combustion equipment. What is the most economical energy to produce heat? In the 21st century, the most economical form of heat production is electricity, as it is generated using renewable energy. In process heat, the energy cost of using electricity is about 50% lower than with combustion systems. By providing us with the heat process data, we guarantee the energy cost of our technology in writing. Aerothermal energy or ETE electrical equipment?

Air-water aerothermal energy is a technology that captures heat from the outside air and sends it indoors. The equipment’s performance depends on the outside temperature and is unstable. ETE equipment uses technology that delivers 100% stable performance over its long lifespan with no maintenance costs. Aerothermal energy has a water temperature limitation; ETE equipment always operates at the temperature desired by the customer.

How is ETE different from its competitors?
  • Experience and technology are the values ​​that place ETE electrical equipment at the top of the market.
  • There are more than 20,000 units installed worldwide, for all types of heating processes, industry, and comfort.
  • Our competition sells equipment. Thermic Electric Solutions sells heating services, guaranteeing both heating service and energy consumption.
What is Thermic Electric Solutions' position on obsolescence? Since the company’s founding in 1977, the guiding principles of our operations have been ethical, respectful of the environment, and respect for the life of our equipment. It’s normal for our equipment for heating, bakeries, spas, hot yoga centers, and industrial processes to go more than 30 years without breakdowns or maintenance costs. Are ETE electric heating equipment prices competitive? Can we compare the price of an electric bicycle with that of an electric car? Both are useful for getting around, but the service they provide is different. The technology of ETE electric heating equipment cannot be compared with that manufactured by other companies, as they use very basic technology and are prone to breakdowns. ETE equipment is a proven and safe technology. Are spare parts for ETE electrical equipment expensive? Breakdowns rarely occur, so spare parts are not necessary. When designing our equipment, we use 90% of components available on the international market, and they are easy to purchase anywhere in the world. Upon request, we can recommend components we have in stock for emergency intervention. Can ETE heating equipment be installed with photovoltaic and wind panels?

Of course, our equipment, both industrial and residential, can be connected to photovoltaic and wind panels.

Our recommendation is to first purchase ETE equipment, install it, powered by the grid, and after a few months of consumption, send the utility bills to the solar panel supplier so they can provide you with a quote for the power needed for both industrial and residential use.

The combustion boiler power is not taken into account.\n\nMass to be heated x thermal difference x specific heat x time = kilocalories.<\/strong>\n\nExample: heating 5,000 liters of vegetable oil from 20\u00b0C to 80\u00b0C in one hour. Specific heat of vegetable oil 0.40, thermal difference 60\u00b0C. The kW produces 860 kilocalories.\n\n5,000 x 60 = 300,000. 300,000 x 0.40 = 120,000 kcal\/h. The electrical power of the equipment is 120,000:860 = 139 kW. A 139 kW water treatment plant will be installed, operating at 110\u00b0C.","_id":"6e9e424"},{"item_label":"Do you want to remove the combustion heating equipment and install an electric one?","item_active":"","content_type":"editor","item_editor_content":"You provide us with the heating process data, and our technicians will calculate the power you need. This is typically 50 to 70% less than combustion equipment.","_id":"4f4a6f2"},{"item_label":"What is the most economical energy to produce heat?","item_active":"","content_type":"editor","item_editor_content":"In the 21st century, the most economical form of heat production is electricity, as it is generated using renewable energy. In process heat, the energy cost of using electricity is about 50% lower than with combustion systems. By providing us with the heat process data, we guarantee the energy cost of our technology in writing.","_id":"34d2c82"},{"item_label":"Aerothermal energy or ETE electrical equipment?","item_active":"","content_type":"editor","item_editor_content":"

      Air-water aerothermal energy is a technology that captures heat from the outside air and sends it indoors. The equipment's performance depends on the outside temperature and is unstable. ETE equipment uses technology that delivers 100% stable performance over its long lifespan with no maintenance costs. Aerothermal energy has a water temperature limitation; ETE equipment always operates at the temperature desired by the customer.<\/p>","_id":"19c600c"},{"item_label":"How is ETE different from its competitors?","item_active":"","content_type":"editor","item_editor_content":"

Thermic Electric Solutions sells heating services, guaranteeing both heating service and energy consumption.<\/li><\/ul>","_id":"9a6d696"},{"item_label":"What is Thermic Electric Solutions' position on obsolescence?","item_active":"","content_type":"editor","item_editor_content":"Since the company's founding in 1977, the guiding principles of our operations have been ethical, respectful of the environment, and respect for the life of our equipment.\n\nIt's normal for our equipment for heating, bakeries, spas, hot yoga centers, and industrial processes to go more than 30 years without breakdowns or maintenance costs.","_id":"f1a6e90"},{"item_label":"Are ETE electric heating equipment prices competitive?","item_active":"","content_type":"editor","item_editor_content":"Can we compare the price of an electric bicycle with that of an electric car? Both are useful for getting around, but the service they provide is different.\n\nThe technology of ETE electric heating equipment cannot be compared with that manufactured by other companies, as they use very basic technology and are prone to breakdowns. ETE equipment is a proven and safe technology.","_id":"8b32f5c"},{"item_label":"Are spare parts for ETE electrical equipment expensive?","item_active":"","content_type":"editor","item_editor_content":"Breakdowns rarely occur, so spare parts are not necessary.\n\nWhen designing our equipment, we use 90% of components available on the international market, and they are easy to purchase anywhere in the world.\n\nUpon request, we can recommend components we have in stock for emergency intervention.","_id":"4584b87"},{"item_label":"Can ETE heating equipment be installed with photovoltaic and wind panels?","item_active":"","content_type":"editor","item_editor_content":"

        Of course, our equipment, both industrial and residential, can be connected to photovoltaic and wind panels.<\/p>

        Our recommendation is to first purchase ETE equipment, install it, powered by the grid, and after a few months of consumption, send the utility bills to the solar panel supplier so they can provide you with a quote for the power needed for both industrial and residential use.<\/p>","_id":"066b519"}],"collapsible":"","toggle_label_typography_typography":"custom","toggle_label_typography_font_family":"Heebo","toggle_label_typography_text_transform":"uppercase","toggle_icon_box_popover_toggle":"custom","toggle_icon_box_box_font_color":"#000000","toggle_icon_box_background":"color","toggle_icon_box_color":"#FFF","toggle_label_color_active":"#ED2124","toggle_icon_box_active_popover_toggle":"custom","toggle_icon_box_active_background":"color","toggle_icon_box_active_color":"#FFF","tabs_content_typography_text_transform":"uppercase","__globals__":{"toggle_label_color_active":"globals\/colors?id=secondary","toggle_control_background_color":"","toggle_icon_box_color":"globals\/colors?id=591ec5ab","toggle_icon_box_box_font_color":"globals\/colors?id=primary","toggle_icon_box_active_color":"globals\/colors?id=591ec5ab","toggle_icon_box_active_box_font_color":"globals\/colors?id=secondary"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"jet-accordion"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

Technology to build a Hot Yoga center - Bikram

Exercise room with clean air, balanced temperature, optimal humidity

We have the comprehensive solution for your Hot Yoga – Bikram Hot Pilates center. Our equipment will provide air conditioning for the room so that classes are held at the optimal temperature and humidity, providing clean air. We eliminate CO2 so you can breathe oxygen in a room full of exercising students. Finally, we guarantee hot water in the showers.

Our innovative design allows us to recommend energy-efficient equipment to our clients with a service guarantee, generating significant savings in fixed and variable energy costs.

  • HYB Equipment – Air conditioning for the fitness room to maintain 40°C and 50% humidity. These values ​​can be modified on the equipment. Depending on the size of the room, you can choose between two different power levels or combine them for larger rooms.
  • REC Equipment – To clean the air, eliminate the CO2 generated by people when breathing, and balance humidity and temperature.
  • MAM or 38 Relax Equipment – To provide hot water for showers, our technology saves more than 70% compared to other systems.
  • Etecooler – To cool shower water to 6°C
  • Showers – Electronic timers with a mixing valve.

The electricity consumption with ete air-conditioning-cleaning-water equipment for a 90-minute class in an 80 m2 room with 22 students is €2 per class.

Our equipment requires no maintenance.

Our technicians advise on installation and provide hydraulic, electrical, and ventilation diagrams.

Backed by over 40 years of research into heat production with electricity, the centers with our equipment are the healthiest for students and the most profitable for their investors.

The Yoga Bikram Barquillo center has been built with ete equipment

Book a 90-minute class. With experience, you'll discover that it offers optimal conditions for practicing Hot Yoga, with clean air, just the right humidity and temperature.

Visit our website

FAQs

Who is Thermic Electric Solutions? We have been manufacturing electric heating equipment since 1977. We manufacture water, superheated water, thermal oil, and steam for industry, bakery equipment, spa equipment, swimming pool equipment, sanitary water, heating, and Bikram Hot Yoga centers. You have a heat process, you want to improve it.
  • Provide us with the process data and our technicians will calculate the equipment’s power and temperature.
  • We guarantee the heating service you need in writing.
  • The goal is to save on your energy bill every month and prevent air pollution.
What does ETE bring to the Hot Yoga Bikram Facilities?
  • Their experience in facility design.
  • The exercise rooms have an optimal climate and air quality for workouts, generating massive customer attendance.
  • The energy cost of a 100 m2 exercise room is €2 per 90-minute class, including hot water for showers.
Thinking about starting a Bikram Hot Yoga center? The energy expenditure in a 100m2 exercise room is €2 per 90-minute class, including the cost of hot water for showers. How is ETE different from its competitors?
  • Experience and technology are the values ​​that place ETE electrical equipment at the top of the market.
  • There are more than 20,000 units installed worldwide, for all types of heating processes, industry, and comfort.
  • Our competition sells equipment. Thermic Electric Solutions sells heating services, guaranteeing both heating service and energy consumption.
What is Thermic Electric Solutions' position on obsolescence? Since the company’s founding in 1977, the guiding principles of our operations have been ethical, respectful of the environment, and respect for the life of our equipment. It’s normal for our equipment for heating, bakeries, spas, hot yoga centers, and industrial processes to go more than 30 years without breakdowns or maintenance costs. Are ETE electric heating equipment prices competitive? Can we compare the price of an electric bicycle with that of an electric car? Both are useful for getting around, but the service they provide is different. The technology of ETE electric heating equipment cannot be compared with that manufactured by other companies, as they use very basic technology and are prone to breakdowns. ETE equipment is a proven and safe technology. Are spare parts for ETE electrical equipment expensive? Breakdowns rarely occur, so spare parts are not necessary. When designing our equipment, we use 90% of components available on the international market, and they are easy to purchase anywhere in the world. Upon request, we can recommend components we have in stock for emergency intervention. Can ETE heating equipment be installed with photovoltaic and wind panels?

Of course, our equipment, both industrial and residential, can be connected to photovoltaic and wind panels.

Our recommendation is to first purchase ETE equipment, install it, powered by the grid, and after a few months of consumption, send the utility bills to the solar panel supplier so they can provide you with a quote for the power needed for both industrial and residential use.

item.title: Technology
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
TECHNOLOGY

REQUEST A QUOTE

Thermic Electric SOLUTIONS (ETE)

At Thermic Electric Solutions (ETE), we have been designing and manufacturing custom-made electrical heating equipment for industrial processes, bakeries, spas, homes, swimming pools, and specialized centers since 1977. Our philosophy is clear: robust, efficient, and trouble-free equipment with predictable energy consumption guaranteed in writing. We do not sell standard machines, but rather customized thermal solutions, the result of an initial technical study and in-house engineering that ensures that each unit is precisely tailored to the customer's needs.

Consulting and Engineering Services

Fast, competitive, close to our client.

Guarantee

10 years in water boiler, super-heated water boiler, thermal oil boilers.

Teleservice

Telephone technical support.

Smart installation and maintenance

Easy for any professional in any part of the world.

Ecologic Heat

Zero emissions, no explosion or fire risk.

Benefit

Save energy sistematically.

Experience

More than 20.000 industrial boilers installed around the world since 1977.

PROJECTS AROUND THE WORLD

FAQs

Consulting and Own Engineering​ Each project begins with a customized technical analysis. We calculate the exact power (kW) and temperature range (°C) required for the installation, avoiding oversizing and ensuring maximum energy efficiency. Our team supports the client throughout the entire process: design, manufacturing, installation, and commissioning. Manufacturing without obsolescence​ We manufacture equipment designed to last for decades. Thanks to their design and the selection of top-quality components (more than 90% standard and available worldwide), our systems:
  • Maintain 100% stable performance throughout their entire useful life.
  • Operate for more than 30 years without breakdowns or maintenance.
  • Dramatically reduce the total cost of ownership compared to combustion boilers or basic technologies.
Guarantee and predictable costs​ With each ETE unit, we provide a written guarantee of the heating service and energy consumption. This allows the customer to accurately understand their operating costs and confidently plan the profitability of their investment. Telecare and ease of installation​ All our systems include complete technical documentation (installation, commissioning, and efficient use). Installation can be performed by any professional plumber or electrician anywhere in the world. We also offer direct remote assistance to support the customer in real time if needed. Clean and ecological heat​
  • Zero polluting emissions.
  • No risk of fire or explosion.
  • Direct integration with renewable energy sources such as photovoltaics.
International experience​ With more than 20,000 units installed worldwide and more than 600 thermal and wellness centers developed, our technology is present in industries, bakeries, hotels, spas, and homes on different continents. 👉 ETE doesn't manufacture boilers, it manufactures trust. Proprietary technology, expert consulting, and a custom manufacturing model that ensures each client’s efficiency, safety, and long-term profitability.

item.title: Electric Steam Boiler
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
ELECTRIC STEAM BOILER

REQUEST A QUOTE

TECHNOLOGY TO GUARANTEE HEAT SERVICE AND A LONG LIFE WITHOUT BREAKDOWNS

If you are a bakery professional, you know well the importance of steam in the baking process, to improve the quality of the bread.

You also know the expenses that are produced to clean the steamers and the ovens are aged with the contribution of water to produce steam.

If your oven is for floors, cars, rockers, rotary, hearth, continuous tape, etc., you have to provide steam when you introduce the bread, to improve the quality, give color, shine, thin crust, volume. You need to sell your customers a loaf with an attractive presentation every day that encourages them to buy it.

You can count on ete technicians, they have been working with the bakery sector since 1980 and they adapt steam boilers to the type of oven you have.

Steam boilers for bakery steam oven have been installed in hundreds of bakeries in the last 35 years both in the air conditioning of the fermentation chambers and in the supply of our equipment to provide clean steam to the ovens.

If you have multiple ovens you can install one kit for each oven or one kit to service all the ovens. The installation of the steam production equipment ete is very simple and is done by the plumber and electrician in your area in about 5 hours.

You pay for the cost of installing the steam production equipment by saving the oven's cleaning costs, the life of the oven is prolonged for many years and the quality of the product that is produced allows you to sell more bread.

In many cases the baker had planned to change the oven, by installing ete steam production equipment the oven has continued to operate for many years making a higher quality product.

Provide the characteristics of your furnaces to ete technicians, they will send you information on the most economical suitable equipment to improve your production.

item.title: Equipment for Fermentation Chamber
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
EQUIPMENT FOR FERMENTATION CHAMBER

ETE EQUIPMENT FOR MAKING QUALITY BREAD

Fermentation

In 1978, we began researching the bread fermentation process. We studied how bread was made before the use of pressed or powdered yeast, and we built the first air-conditioning system for the room where the bread carts are placed. After a year of testing, we managed to maintain a permanent temperature of 33°C in the fermentation chamber, 80% humidity, and the same temperature and humidity throughout the entire facility, ensuring that all the breads fermented evenly. We found that installing our LAUDA equipment reduced the amount of baking powder used by 80%, improving color, flavor, and shelf life. With the money they saved on yeast, they paid for the equipment in less than a year. There are currently more than 2,000 units in operation, and older units have been replaced with newer units built with more durable materials, finer temperature controls, and improved heat and humidity to improve bread quality.

GOOD BREAD

When bread rises with baking powder, the grain doesn't transform, and the stomach and intestines can't assimilate the nutrients. Yeast doesn't produce fermentation, it only makes the dough rise.

ETE BREAD AND PASTRY FERMENTATION EQUIPMENT

  • We manufacture three LAUDA models, depending on the size of a fermentation chamber up to 30 m³. Depending on the size, various units can be installed inside or outside the chamber.
  • LAUDA equipment features a steam boiler that adds humidity to the air in the fermentation chamber, which is controlled at 80% with a digital hygrostat.
  • The heat is provided by a group of resistances that operate at low temperatures to prevent the oxygen in the air from burning and harming fermentation.
  • It provides the heat needed by the dough to carry out the biological process of fermentation, transforming the flour so that the nutrients in the grain can be assimilated by the human body.
  • Installation is simple. The equipment requires no maintenance.
BREAD FERMENTATION

Lauda-15 6 15
Lauda-30 12 30

item.title: Bakery
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
BAKERY

TECHNOLOGY TO GUARANTEE HEAT SERVICE AND A LONG LIFE WITHOUT BREAKDOWNS

ELECTRIC
STEAM BOILERS

Equipment for
Fementation Chamber

FAQs

Who is Thermic Electric Solutions? We have been manufacturing electric heating equipment since 1977. We manufacture water, superheated water, thermal oil, and steam for industry, bakery equipment, spa equipment, swimming pool equipment, sanitary water, heating, and Bikram Hot Yoga centers. You have a heat process, you want to improve it.
  • Provide us with the process data and our technicians will calculate the equipment’s power and temperature.
  • We guarantee the heating service you need in writing.
  • The goal is to save on your energy bill every month and prevent air pollution.
What are the advantages of ETE equipment for bakeries?
  • Bread proofing equipment saves more than 80% of yeast and significantly improves the flavor, aroma, and presentation of the bread.
  • Steam oven equipment improves the presentation of the bread and does not stain the interior of the oven.
How is ETE different from its competitors?
  • Experience and technology are the values ​​that place ETE electrical equipment at the top of the market.
  • There are more than 20,000 units installed worldwide, for all types of heating processes, industry, and comfort.
  • Our competition sells equipment. Thermic Electric Solutions sells heating services, guaranteeing both heating service and energy consumption.
What is Thermic Electric Solutions' position on obsolescence? Since the company’s founding in 1977, the guiding principles of our operations have been ethical, respectful of the environment, and respect for the life of our equipment. It’s normal for our equipment for heating, bakeries, spas, hot yoga centers, and industrial processes to go more than 30 years without breakdowns or maintenance costs. Are ETE electric heating equipment prices competitive? Can we compare the price of an electric bicycle with that of an electric car? Both are useful for getting around, but the service they provide is different. The technology of ETE electric heating equipment cannot be compared with that manufactured by other companies, as they use very basic technology and are prone to breakdowns. ETE equipment is a proven and safe technology. Are spare parts for ETE electrical equipment expensive? Breakdowns rarely occur, so spare parts are not necessary. When designing our equipment, we use 90% of components available on the international market, and they are easy to purchase anywhere in the world. Upon request, we can recommend components we have in stock for emergency intervention. Can ETE heating equipment be installed with photovoltaic and wind panels?

Of course, our equipment, both industrial and residential, can be connected to photovoltaic and wind panels.

Our recommendation is to first purchase ETE equipment, install it, powered by the grid, and after a few months of consumption, send the utility bills to the solar panel supplier so they can provide you with a quote for the power needed for both industrial and residential use.

item.title: Bithermal Jet Shower Essential Oil
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
BITHERMAL JET SHOWER ESSENTIAL OIL

REQUEST A QUOTE

BITHERMAL JET SHOWER ESSENTIAL OIL

The Bithermal Jet with essential oil manufactured by ete is used for hydromassage treatments; it produces contrast of hot water (39ºC) and cold water (4ºC). The therapist controls the pressure, temperature and cycles. It is a corporal massage complete or partial based on water contrast and pressure for which a specialist is needed. The originality of this equipment is the essential oil for stimulating or relaxing, the use is under the therapist criteria. The therapist can program the hot-cold cycles, time, pressure and the number of cycles. The bithermal jet has a temperature regulation system, pressure and digital lecture.

Measures

Base 505 x 325 mm. Height 845mm

Power

30 W – 230 V II

Therapeutic application

It is very useful for people who suffer rheumatic process, osteoarthritis, skin disorders, obesity, painful shoulder, cellulites treatment and get shape. With this therapy the join and muscle pain decrease. Ask more information about our equipment for free

item.title: Scottish Bithermal Shower
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
SCOTTISH BITHERMAL SHOWER

REQUEST A QUOTE

SCOTTISH BITHERMAL SHOWER

The Scottish Bithermal Shower manufactured by ete is essential afterwards heat treatments, its use helps to balance the circulatory system. The Scottish Bithermal Shower has 3 circuits with 6 sprinkles each y one circuit with a 100mm diameter shower head, those circuits will work stepwise and automatically. To get a real therapeutic effect, the hot water should be at 40ºC and the cold water under 10ºC. ete manufactures the equipment to heat and chill the water with service guarantee. Ask more information about our equipment for free.

item.title: Bithermal Oil Shower
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
BITHERMAL OIL SHOWER

REQUEST A QUOTE

Bithermal Oil Shower

Equipment for 40º hot and 8ºC cold water cycle showers. It serves to balance the circulatory system by providing water-soluble oils in cold water at 8ºC. The equipment has a processor with a button panel to provide only 40ºC hot water, only 8ºC cold water or hot-cold cycles, and it also has a 100mm diameter sprinkler. The control module can program the times of hot water 40ºC, cold water 8ºC and number of times you want to repeat the hot-cold cycle. The essential oils are diluted in water and their contribution, once the shower is scheduled, will be done in cold water times, to avoid altering them. This shower will be supplied with hot water at 40ºC and cold water at 8ºC. ete manufactures water heaters and chiller to service bithermal showers. Request more information about our spa equipment for free.

The equipment has a processor with a button panel to provide only 40\u00baC hot water, only 8\u00baC cold water or hot-cold cycles, and it also has a 100mm diameter sprinkler.<\/p>

The control module can program the times of hot water 40\u00baC, cold water 8\u00baC and number of times you want to repeat the hot-cold cycle. The essential oils are diluted in water and their contribution, once the shower is scheduled, will be done in cold water times, to avoid altering them.<\/p>

This shower will be supplied with hot water at 40\u00baC and cold water at 8\u00baC. ete<\/span> manufactures water heaters and chiller to service bithermal showers.<\/p>

item.title: Pail Shower
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
PAIL SHOWER

REQUEST A QUOTE

PAIL SHOWER

The Pail Shower manufactured by ete has a 20 liters capacity; the pail will be filled in 15 seconds with hot or cold water according to the cliente chose. The pail is constructed in aluminum or wood with auto-filling system and control panel. To get a real therapeutic effect, is it important that the hot water temperature be 40ºC and the cold water to 8ºC. ete manufactures the water heaters and the chillers to give this service. Ask more information about our equipment for free.

MIST SHOWER

REQUEST A QUOTE

MIST SHOWER

The Mist Shower manufactured by ete has a shower head with 6 sprayers of 2.5 liters/minute, built in stainless steel.

To get a real therapeutic effect, the hot water should be at 40ºC and the cold water to 8ºC. ete manufactures the equipment to heat and chill the water with service guarantee.

Shower head diameter

37,40cm

Power

9W

Control panel measures

Base 330x mm. | Height 260mm. | Depth 130mm.

Ask more information about our products for free.

FAQs

Who is Thermic Electric Solutions? We have been manufacturing electric heating equipment since 1977. We manufacture water, superheated water, thermal oil, and steam for industry, bakery equipment, spa equipment, swimming pool equipment, sanitary water, heating, and Bikram Hot Yoga centers. You have a heat process, you want to improve it.
  • Provide us with the process data and our technicians will calculate the equipment’s power and temperature.
  • We guarantee the heating service you need in writing.
  • The goal is to save on your energy bill every month and prevent air pollution.
What do ETE equipment contribute to thermal spa facilities?
  • Since 1977, we have perfected the technology for manufacturing spa equipment, passive sweating, relaxation, pool heating, pool cooling, shower heating, shower cooling, and bi-thermal showers. Much of our equipment has been in operation for over 40 years.
  • Above all, we contribute our experience in designing spa centers so that they are economically profitable and attract many customers due to the health benefits they provide.
Thinking about installing a thermal spa, a balneary, or a hammam?

Above all, what we contribute is our experience in designing spa centers so that they are economically profitable and attract many clients due to the health benefits they provide.

How is ETE different from its competitors?
  • Experience and technology are the values ​​that place ETE electrical equipment at the top of the market.
  • There are more than 20,000 units installed worldwide, for all types of heating processes, industry, and comfort.
  • Our competition sells equipment. Thermic Electric Solutions sells heating services, guaranteeing both heating service and energy consumption.
What is Thermic Electric Solutions' position on obsolescence? Since the company’s founding in 1977, the guiding principles of our operations have been ethical, respectful of the environment, and respect for the life of our equipment. It’s normal for our equipment for heating, bakeries, spas, hot yoga centers, and industrial processes to go more than 30 years without breakdowns or maintenance costs. Are ETE electric heating equipment prices competitive? Can we compare the price of an electric bicycle with that of an electric car? Both are useful for getting around, but the service they provide is different. The technology of ETE electric heating equipment cannot be compared with that manufactured by other companies, as they use very basic technology and are prone to breakdowns. ETE equipment is a proven and safe technology. Are spare parts for ETE electrical equipment expensive? Breakdowns rarely occur, so spare parts are not necessary. When designing our equipment, we use 90% of components available on the international market, and they are easy to purchase anywhere in the world. Upon request, we can recommend components we have in stock for emergency intervention. Can ETE heating equipment be installed with photovoltaic and wind panels?

Of course, our equipment, both industrial and residential, can be connected to photovoltaic and wind panels.

Our recommendation is to first purchase ETE equipment, install it, powered by the grid, and after a few months of consumption, send the utility bills to the solar panel supplier so they can provide you with a quote for the power needed for both industrial and residential use.

ELECTRONIC TIMER SHOWER

REQUEST A QUOTE

Electronic timer shower

The Electronic Timer Shower manufactured by ete has been created to give an excellent service and save water, energy and money. It is the ideal shower for gyms, factories, barracks, mines, etc. If you install our Electronic Timer Shower you will save between 70% and 90% in the energy and water bill. The electric consumption is 7w, easy installation. It is suitable for new or old facilities. Ask more information about our products for free.

item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
COLD WATER ETECOOLER

REQUEST A QUOTE

COLD WATER ETECOOLER

The Equipment for cooling shower water and toning pools manufactured by ete is used in wellness centers as an essential element for their success as a thermal center. Every wellness center should install the etecooler for bithermal showers or toning pools, the water should be under 10ºC to get a real therapeutic effect. Our recommendation is 8ºC for showers and 10ºC for pools. The equipment manufactured by ete is exclusively created for this use with service guarantee. It is important install exclusively our bithermal showers for saving water, energy and excellent service. Ask more information about our products for free.

item.title: Flotarium
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
FLOTARIUM

REQUEST A QUOTE

Flotarium

The Electric Boiler for Flotarium manufactured by ete is the ideal system to balance physical and mental; it produces the same feeling like you are floating in the Dead Sea. The pool for this use should be constructed with cement, brick and finished with tiles. Important: The kind of salt use for this system can be: marine, magnesium or rock salt. The concentration must be 30%. We recommend a 2m x 2m space per person therefore for a 10 person pool the measures are 2m x 20m x 0,5m. The water temperature should be 36ºC. To guarantee the therapeutic efficiency the recommendations given are mandatory. Ask more information about our equipment for free.

item.title: Compostela Pediluve
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
COMPOSTELA PEDILUVE

REQUEST A QUOTE

compostela pediluve

The Equipment for Compostela Pediluve manufactured by ete is used for reflexology treatments to activate the legs blood circulation. The equipment produces hot and cold-water cycles. To get a real therapeutic effect is it important that the hot water temperature be 40ºC and the cold water less than 10ºC. ete manufactures the water heaters and the chillers to give this service. It is a path constructed by masonry, floor with pebbles. We recommend: 5m long and 80cm width path for walk. The path for the pediluve can be straight, spiral or any other way. Ask more information about our products for free.

item.title: Air-Treatment Equipment
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
AIR-TREATMENT EQUIPMENT

REQUEST A QUOTE

ETE AIR-TREATMENT EQUIPMENT

The air treatment equipment is ideal for residential and commercial applications and offers concrete energy savings in forced ventilation installations, using a static exchanger built in aluminum that allows saving more than 50% of the thermal energy of the premises than otherwise it would be lost with the stale air expelled.

The air treatment equipment is available in 10 sizes, for air volumes ranging from 300 to 6800 m3/h; It is particularly suitable for installation in a false ceiling and can be appropriately channeled to allow the supply and extraction of ambient air.

Tell us the characteristics of the premises you want to ventilate; our technical department will study the ideal air treatment equipment. When the order passes, we will also provide you with the plans for the installation of ducts and grids.

Also visit our industrial boilers carbon neutral.

Timer Shower With Mixer

REQUEST A QUOTE

Timer Shower With Mixer

The Electronic Timer Shower manufactured by ete has been created to give an excellent service and save water, energy and money. It is the ideal shower for gyms, factories, barracks, mines, etc. If you install our Electronic Timer Shower you will save between 70% and 90% in the energy and water bill. The electric consumption is 7w, easy installation. It is suitable for new or old facilities. The shower includes mixer to regulate the water temperature. Ask more information about our products for free.

item.title: Cold Water Tunnel
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
COLD WATER TUNNEL

REQUEST A QUOTE

COLD WATER TUNNEL

The Cold-Water Tunnel manufactured by ete it is an alternative for the toning pools. It is a vasodilator for internal organs and a vasoconstrictor for the blood flow. To get a real therapeutic effect, the hot water should be at 40ºC and the cold water to 8ºC. ete manufactures the equipment to heat and chill the water with service guarantee. Voltage 230 V II – 50/60 Hz. Power 9 W. Ask more information about our products for free.

item.title: Bithermal Tunnel
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
Bithermal tunnel

REQUEST A QUOTE

Bithermal tunnel

The Bithermal Tunnel manufactured by ete it is used to revitalized the body between or afterwards the heat treatments. The Bithermal Tunnel includes:
  • Hot water shower model Grand Shower rain effect
  • Cold mist water
  • Pail Shower: cascade of hot water
  • Cold Shower with essential oils
To get a real therapeutic effect is it important that the hot water temperature be 40ºC and the cold water to 8ºC. ete manufactures the water heaters and the chillers to give this service. Voltage 230 V II,50/60 Hz. Power 9 W. Ask more information about our product for free.

item.content:encoded:
VICHY SHOWER

REQUEST A QUOTE

BITHERMAL VICHY SHOWER

The Bithermal Vichy Shower manufactured by ete is used for massage with mud and algae. To get a real therapeutic effect, the hot water should be at 40ºC and the cold water to 8ºC. ete manufactures the equipment to heat and chill the water with service guarantee. The Bithermal Vichy Shower system has a control panel where the heat-cold cycles can be chosen. Table for vichy shower: waterproof, fiberglass finish. It includes an elastic and soft mad. Ask more information about our products for free.

item.title: Cookies Policy
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
REQUEST A QUOTE A cookie is a small text file that is stored in your browser when you visit almost any web page. Its usefulness is that the web is able to remember your visit when you return to browse that page. Cookies usually store information of a technical nature, personal preferences, content personalization, usage statistics, links to social networks, access to user accounts, etc. The objective of the cookie is to adapt the content of the web to your profile and needs, without cookies the services offered by any page would be significantly reduced.

Cookies used on this website

Following the guidelines of the Spanish Agency for Data Protection we proceed to detail the use of cookies made by this website in order to inform you as accurately as possible. This website uses the following own cookies:
  • Session cookies, to guarantee that the users who write comments on the blog are human and not automated applications. In this way, spam is fought.
This website uses the following third-party cookies:
  • Google Analytics: Stores cookies to be able to compile statistics on the traffic and volume of visits to this website. By using this website you are consenting to the processing of information about you by Google. Therefore, the exercise of any right in this regard must be done by communicating directly with Google.
  • Social networks: Each social network uses its own cookies so that you can click on buttons such as Like or Share.

Deactivation or deletion of cookies

At any time you can exercise your right to deactivate or delete cookies from this website. These actions are performed differently depending on the browser you are using.

Additional notes

  • Neither this website nor its legal representatives are responsible for the content or the veracity of the privacy policies that the third parties mentioned in this cookie policy may have.
  • Web browsers are the tools in charge of storing cookies and from this place you must exercise your right to eliminate or deactivate them. Neither this website nor its legal representatives can guarantee the correct or incorrect manipulation of cookies by the aforementioned browsers.
  • In some cases it is necessary to install cookies so that the browser does not forget your decision not to accept them.
  • In the case of Google Analytics cookies, this company stores cookies on servers located in the United States and agrees not to share it with third parties, except in cases where it is necessary for the operation of the system or when the law requires for this purpose. According to Google, it does not save your IP address. Google Inc. is a company adhered to the Safe Harbor Agreement that guarantees that all transferred data will be treated with a level of protection in accordance with European regulations.
  • For any questions or queries about this cookie policy, do not hesitate to contact us through the contact section.

item.title: Thermal Oil Boilers
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
ETE is the brand we develop at Thermic Electric Solutions S.L.U. Our mission is to manufacture thermal oil boilers and a whole range of electrical heat production appliances. We seek to supply energy-efficient appliances for which we guarantee high performance. To do that we use cutting-edge technology as well as the most environmentally friendly solutions possible.

Thermal oil boilers, also known as thermal fluid boilers, are those that use as a fluid a thermal oil which has a very high vaporisation temperature. That means that high temperatures may be worked with at moderate pressure.

Thermal oil boilers have several advantages over more conventional types of boiler, such as needing less parts. In fact, all they need is the boiler itself, pressure and temperature, and recirculation pumps. As they work at lower pressure than other types of boiler, they also need less maintenance. The fluid’s viscosity makes leaks less likely than in steam boilers or hot water boilers.

As suppliers, at Thermic Electric Solutions S.L.U. we have more than forty years’ experience in fitting every type of boiler and heating equipment all over the world. Thermal oil boilers are based on closed-circuit systems and are very simple to operate. The circuit must be filled with thermal oil fluid and degassed, then the main pump starts it up by pumping oil out of the device and into the boiler. After switching on the boiler, the required temperature must be selected on its built-in electrical panel.

ETE thermal oil boilers use ground-breaking technology

Thermal oil boilers are used in heat production devices which need to work on processes at temperatures of up to 300 ºC.

One of the advantages of ETE brand industrial thermal oil boilers is that they perform at 100% and come with a 2-year guarantee. ETE has developed technology which manages to solve traditional problems with thermal oil devices: it does not block pipes, moulds or coils, neither does it impair pumps or valves and maintenance costs may be practically cut to nil. Our thermal oil boilers save on installation costs, energy consumption and maintenance costs, and you will see how the working life of your boiler is increased.

Our company offers not only the best guarantee, but also has its own consulting and engineering service. We take care of fitting and smartly maintaining our products and make our experience available to clients.

item.title: Hot water boilers
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
ETE (Europea Térmica Eléctrica) is the brand we develop at Thermic Electric Solutions S.L.U. to design and manufacture water and superheated water boilers, appliances for Bikram Hot Yoga centres, resorts, spas and bakeries, our four main production lines. We are an engineering company which manufactures electrical heat production equipment.

By means of our hot water boilers and the rest of our energy efficient products and services, we strive to offer our clients the best solutions possible. Therefore we update all the time to use the most ground-breaking technology on the market while implementing environmentally friendly solutions. Working in our favour is over forty years’ experience in fitting industrial electric water boilers all over the world, in which time we have had countless satisfied customers.

In the 1990s heat production underwent a major paradigm shift due to the onset of renewable technologies, like thermal-solar, photovoltaic, wind and hydroelectric power, which meant a drive towards using electricity to produce heat. For this reason, reliance was minimised on fuel-burning devices,  which caused much more pollution and were also less profitable.  ETE hot water boilers use the heat production technology that technicians use nowadays.

Hot water boilers suited to today’s technology

ETE industrial electric water boilers are manufactured based on an unerring mix of using top-quality materials and modern technology. This all allows us to offer a 2-year guarantee on hot water boilers and ensure service throughout their working lives. In the design and fitting process, ETE professionals work with customers to estimate each process’s heat requirements. We thus avoid overestimates, which saves on the electricity bill. Furthermore, we guarantee in writing the service that the customer needs.

The advantage of using ETE superheated water boilers over steam boilers entails a range of benefits, amongst which we may list not needing to fit condensate drains and also avoiding problems with corrosion. Fitting our hot water boilers means simplifying pipeline networks and installation, as is the case with control and regulation systems. Maintenance requirements and costs are thus minimised.

To fit hot water boilers the same principles need to be followed as for water devices i.e. assessing the temperature and pressure that will be needed when choosing materials.

Our company stands out for offering the best guarantee. Furthermore, we have our own consulting and engineering service, take care of fitting and smartly maintaining our products, and make our experience available to clients.

Look for more information on the uses of steam boilers.

item.title: Steam Boilers
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
At ETE we are experts in manufacturing electrical heat production equipment, including steam boilers, thermal oil boilers, industrial boilers carbon neutral, etc. Thermic Electric Solutions S.L.U. is the company behind the ETE brand, which is known for offering long-life products that are practically trouble-free.

Steam boilers are machines that produce steam by using either electrical heating or by burning certain types of fuel.  Steam boilers have many uses in different types of industry, ranging from heating other fluids, sterilising equipment and products, and moisturising air.

Regardless of the system used, a steam boiler’s purpose is to raise water temperature and pressure until it turns into steam at the required pressure.  At ETE we have a catalogue based on four product lines; industrial electric water boilers, devices for Bikram Hot Yoga centres, appliances for spas and resorts, and for bakeries.

ETE steam boilers, economical and reliable

The technology we use to produce ETE steam boilers is much more advanced than that of our competitors, which allows us to guarantee optimal 100% performance throughout a boiler’s working life, which will be more than 30 years. ETE steam boilers have a 2-year guarantee.

At Europea Térmica Eléctrica we take charge of estimating the customer’s power needs for their equipment and guarantee heat service for industrial production processes, heating or any other heat requirement. We specialise in making equipment as simple and economical as possible, which minimises the risk of faults and breakdowns so common for this type of product.

For all our appliances, including steam boilers, we guarantee that maintenance costs will be minimal and breakdowns scarce, and performance will be the same after 20 years’ service as on day one.

Renewable energy has brought down electricity prices, so it is much cheaper than burning fossil fuel as well as being more environmentally friendly. Steam boilers’ performance declines over time, something that is not the case with ETE electric steam boilers.

Some of the benefits enjoyed by customers who opt for fitting an ETE steam boiler or hot water boiler are cheaper electricity bills and lower maintenance costs.  By the same token, the number of shut-downs needed for repairs is reduced.  As specialists with 40 years’ experience in the sector, we guarantee rational and simple heating appliances.  Furthermore, they are safe and environmentally friendly appliances. 

Find more information about our oil hot water boiler.

Renewable energy has brought down electricity prices, so it is much cheaper than burning fossil fuel as well as being more environmentally friendly. Steam boilers’ performance declines over time, something that is not the case with ETE electric steam boilers.

item.title: Industrial electric water boilers
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
ETE is the brand we develop at Thermic Electric Solutions S.L.U. to manufacture industrial electric water boilers, appliances for Bikram Hot Yoga centres, resorts, spas and bakeries.   We are an engineering company which manufactures electrical heat production appliances.

Using our industrial electric water, superheated water, steam, and thermal fluid boilers, and the rest of our products, we seek to provide energy efficient equipment.  To do that we use cutting-edge technology as well as environmentally friendly solutions. Working in our favour is over forty years’ experience in fitting industrial electric boilers all over the world.

In the 1990s heat production underwent a major paradigm shift due to the onset of renewable technologies, like thermal-solar, photovoltaic, wind and hydroelectric power, which meant a drive towards using electricity to produce heat. For this reason, reliance was minimised on fuel-burning devices,  which caused much more pollution and were also less profitable. To this end, ETE hot water boilers use the heat production technology that technicians use nowadays.

Using top quality materials combined with modern technology allows us to offer 2-year guarantees on every powerful electric boiler and ensure service throughout the boilers’ working lives. Our technicians work with customers to estimate each process’s heating needs. Furthermore, we guarantee in writing the service that the customer needs.

ETE industrial electric boilers are manufactured with modern technology

Industrial electric water boilers have a electrical power range of between 4.5 and 2,000 kW. On the whole, they are used in any process that needs to produce heat or hot water, to heat up spaces or for heat generation processes in industry.

Amongst others, the advantages of using ETE superheated water boilers include avoiding the need to fit condensate trays and also avoiding problems with corrosion. Fitting our Industrial electric water boilers means simplifying pipeline networks and installation, as is also the case with control and regulation systems. All this means that maintenance needs are minimal.

Industrial electric water boiler equipment follows the same principles as water equipment, and are taken into consideration when choosing materials, temperature and pressure.

Industrial electric water boilers have built-in electrical panels which provide high performance and an accuracy of +/-0.5 ºC. Power may be stepped up in increments, each one of which has its own fail-safe features. As regards safety systems, boilers have a safety thermostat, a relief valve and a pressure safety switch fitted in case water is cut off. The panel works by optical signalling so everything may be checked at a glance.

ETE powerful electric boilers are fitted with rock wool insulation. As for their outside finishing, they are assembled on a tubular chassis with sheet panelling covered in stove-finished epoxy paint.

item.title: Industrial boilers carbon neutral
item.dc:creator: ete-admin
item.content:encoded:
ETE (Europea Térmica Eléctrica) is the brand we develop at Thermic Electric Solutions S.L.U. Our mission as a company is to design and manufacture zero-carbon industrial boilers, appliances for Bikram Hot Yoga centres, resorts, spas and bakeries, our four main product lines. We are an engineering company which manufactures electrical heat production equipment.

By fitting industrial zero-carbon boilers and the rest of our products and appliances, we seek to be as energy efficient as possible.  To do that we strive to offer our customers the best solutions possible, to avoid overestimating their needs so they can save on their bills.

One of our company’s core principles is that we are always updating, which allows us to boast of using the most ground-breaking technology on the market in our industrial electric water boilers, while implementing environmentally friendly solutions.

Working in our favour is over forty years’ experience in fitting industrial zero-carbon boilers in countries across the world while having countless satisfied customers.

ETE takes charge of designing, manufacturing and fitting industrial zero-carbon boilers and other heating equipment which are suited to the most modern and up-to-date technology.

At ETE we are specialists in fitting industrial boilers

ETE steam boilers are manufactured based on an exact mix of using top-quality materials and modern technology. That allows us to offer long warranty periods for all our appliances and to guarantee a minimum breakdown rate.  Furthermore, ETE’s specialist technical staff work directly with customers to estimate every process’s heating needs based on their requirements.

As a company we have been making industrial electric boilers to measure since 1977, using the world’s most advanced technology to do so. ETE electric boilers can replace any type of fuel burning with industrial zero-carbon boilers, and may be replaced by any plumber with the help of an electrician to fit the electric power cable.

ETE technicians provide all the information needed in writing to help make decisions about changing to a safe boiler with a 2-year guarantee. When comparing the cost of a whole season’s heating with that of one of our boilers, it will be seen that consumption is cut by more than 50% and, furthermore, it will give better service and be safer.

The objective of the technology used in the electrical appliances manufactured by ETE to produce hot water for hotels, hospitals, sports facilities, hairdressers, yoga centers, industry, housing blocks or any energy-intensive process, is to guarantee the supply of hot water and optimize energy costs ... At ETE you will find various means of heating, as well as a steam boiler or hot water boiler

Our technology allows us to fit smaller and lower energy devices, which benefits our customers by saving on purchasing equipment and on energy.

The materials used in ETE hot water health equipment allows us to give a 2-year guarantee, although their working life will be more than 20 years.

item.title: Calderas de aceite térmico
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Si trabajas en el sector de la industria y de la energía y estás en búsqueda de una empresa que se dedique a la fabricación de calderas de aceite térmico, has llegado al lugar más indicado. En Thermic Electric Solutions SL, empresa española fundada en 1977, somos fabricantes de equipamiento eléctricos de producción de calor y tenemos a tu disposición un amplio catálogo de productos entre los que destacamos los equipamientos de panadería, los equipamientos de spa y balnearios, generadores de agua caliente y calderas electricas industriales, entre otros. Te podemos asegurar que puedes confiar en nosotros al 100% y con total tranquilidad ya que llevamos trabajando en el sector 40 años, años de experiencia que siempre han girado entorno a la instalación de calderas industriales por todo el mundo.

En definitiva, en Thermic Electric Solutions SL ofrecemos soluciones eléctricas industriales a medida, como por ejemplo la colocación de calderas de aceite térmico, utilizando la tecnología más avanzada del mundo en la fabricación de equipos eléctricos efectos Joule para la producción de calor. Tenemos soluciones para todas las demandas de calor existentes en el mercado y, lo mejor de todo, sin contaminar. Básicamente, nuestro principal objetivo es ofrecer equipos energéticamente eficientes y de alto rendimiento utilizando, como te acabamos de comentar, la tecnología más innovadora y respetuosa con el medio ambiente y, además, todo ello lo realizamos bajo la marca ete. Puedes solicitarnos información y presupuesto sin compromiso desde el formulario de contacto que tenemos en nuestra página web, te ayudaremos encantados.

¿Qué son las calderas de aceite térmico?

Las calderas de aceite térmico se utilizan en los sectores de la industria y la energía para procesos donde es necesario un rango de temperaturas medio y alto, hasta 300ºC. Y es este tipo de caldera aceite térmico industrial las que fabricamos en Thermic Electric Solutions SL, siempre con una tecnología de alta calidad para garantizar un buen servicio de calor y una larga vida sin averías. Estas calderas industriales de aceite térmico, de hasta 300ºC, cuentan con la tecnología de producción de calor más moderna del mercado y que está preparada para resolver los problemas más comunes en este tipo de instalaciones de aceite térmico ya que no obstruye tubos, moldes o serpentines, no deteriora bombas ni válvulas y sus gastos de mantenimiento prácticamente son cero.

Te garantizamos que con nuestras calderas de aceite térmico ete ahorrarás en costes de instalación, consumo de energía, gastos de mantenimiento y aumentará la esperanza de vida de las mismas gracias a la tecnología y a los materiales de construcción que empleamos en su fabricación. Además, nuestras calderas industriales de aceite térmico están diseñadas para evitar el efecto cracking, ofrecen un máximo rendimiento con una precisión +/- 0,5ºC, traen incorporadas una válvula de seguridad por presión y un termostato de seguridad, puedes controlar la temperatura gracias a su termómetro electrónico con lectura de datos y cuentan con varios certificados de calidad, como el CE recipientes a presión, CE baja tensión, CE compatibilidad electromagnética y RITE (España), por destacar algunos. Ya sabes que puedes pedirnos presupuesto sin compromiso desde nuestra web.

item.title: Caldera de aceite térmico industrial
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
En Thermic Electric Solutions SL, expertos en la fabricación de generadores de agua caliente desde 1977, somos una ingeniería que se dedica a la fabricación de equipamientos eléctricos de producción de calor y lo hacemos bajo la marca ete. Básicamente, si contratas una instalación de una caldera aceite térmico industrial con nosotros conseguirás un equipo energéticamente eficiente y de alto rendimiento y con la garantía de haber sido fabricado con la tecnología más innovadora del momento, y sin contaminar ya que es respetuosa con el medio ambiente. Tenemos un amplio catálogo de equipos que se mueven en tres líneas de producción como son las calderas eléctricas industriales, equipamientos de panadería y equipamientos de spa y balnearios, entre otros productos que puedes ver en nuestra página web.

Lo mejor de dejar en nuestras manos la fabricación de una caldera aceite térmico industrial para tu empresa es que, además de que llevamos a nuestras espaldas más de 40 años de experiencia en el sector de la fabricación de equipamientos eléctricos de producción de calor y fabricando para todas las partes del mundo, todos nuestros productos cuentan con 2 años de garantía en calderas de agua, sobrecalentada y fluido térmico. Cuando creamos nuestra empresa, nos marcamos un objetivo bien claro: proporcionar a nuestros clientes equipos energéticamente eficientes, de alto rendimiento y utilizando la última y más avanzada tecnología del mercado, y lo estamos consiguiendo. En nuestra página web tienes toda la información de nuestros servicios y puedes pedirnos presupuesto sin ningún tipo de compromiso.

Empresa experta en fabricación de caldera aceite térmico industrial

Como te hemos comentado más arriba, Thermic Electric Solutions SL es una empresa experta en la fabricación de caldera aceite térmico industrial y, para fabricarlas, utilizamos la tecnología de producción de calor que utilizan los mejores técnicos del siglo XXI, la cual es idónea para resolver los problemas que suelen surgir durante una instalación de calderas de aceite térmico, como por ejemplo el deterioro de válvulas o bombas, la reducción de los gastos de mantenimiento a cero o la obstrucción de tubos, moldes o serpentines. En definitiva, te podemos garantizar que la caldera de aceite térmico que te implementemos te permitirá llevar un consumo de energía más responsable, ahorrar en los costos de instalación y, además, tendrá una esperanza de vida mucho más larga y no sufrirá averías.

Que tu caldera aceite termico industrial tenga una larga vida sin averías es posible gracias a la tecnología y a los materiales de construcción que utilizamos para fabricarla, los cuales, además, te ofrecen una garantía de 2 años. Nuestras instalaciones son muy sencillas y sin complicaciones, y como dato importante, contamos con varios certificados de calidad como son CE recipientes a presión, CE baja tensión, CE compatibilidad electromagnética y RITE (España), entre otros. Por darte algunos detalles de nuestras calderas de aceite térmico, estas están diseñadas para evitar el efecto cracking, están preparadas para soportar temperaturas de hasta 300ºC y diseñadas para un máximo rendimiento con una precisión +/- 0,5ºC. También traen incorporada una válvula de seguridad por presión y puedes controlar la temperatura con su termómetro electrónico. Ya sabes, para más información visita nuestra web.
