item.title: Vapor vs Agua Sobrecalentada vs Aceite Térmico
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Vapor vs Agua Sobrecalentada vs Aceite Térmico

PIDE TU PRESUPUESTO

Elegir entre vapor, agua sobrecalentada y aceite térmico es una decisión clave en el diseño de cualquier sistema térmico industrial. Cada uno de estos fluidos tiene propiedades diferentes, condiciona el tipo de instalación necesaria y ofrece ventajas específicas según la temperatura de trabajo, el tipo de proceso y el nivel de control requerido.

En ETE diseñamos y fabricamos soluciones de calor eléctrico industrial adaptadas a la aplicación concreta de cada cliente. Por eso, más que plantear una comparación genérica, analizamos qué medio de transferencia de calor es el más adecuado para cada proceso, teniendo en cuenta tanto el rendimiento térmico como la seguridad, el mantenimiento y la eficiencia operativa.

Cuándo conviene trabajar con vapor

El vapor ha sido históricamente uno de los fluidos térmicos más utilizados en la industria. Su capacidad para transportar energía y ceder calor de forma rápida lo convierte en una solución habitual en procesos donde se requiere transferencia térmica, calentamiento indirecto o integración con equipos ya diseñados para trabajar con este medio.

Sin embargo, trabajar con vapor también implica tratar el agua, gestionar condensados, purgas y un mantenimiento asociado que debe estar bien resuelta para mantener la eficiencia del sistema.

En proyectos donde ya existe red de vapor o donde el proceso requiere esta tecnología por sus características, puede seguir siendo una opción válida. Aun así, conviene estudiar si realmente es el medio más eficiente o si otras alternativas pueden ofrecer un control más preciso o una operación más sencilla.

 

Qué aporta el agua sobrecalentada en procesos industriales

El agua sobrecalentada permite trabajar a temperaturas elevadas manteniendo el fluido en fase líquida gracias al uso de presión. Es una solución muy interesante cuando se busca una transferencia térmica eficiente, una distribución estable del calor y una gestión más controlada del circuito.

Frente al vapor, el agua sobrecalentada puede ofrecer ventajas en determinadas aplicaciones por su estabilidad y por la reducción de ciertas complejidades asociadas a la generación y recuperación de condensados. Además, resulta adecuada en instalaciones donde se requiere una distribución uniforme del calor en circuitos cerrados y un alto grado de control sobre la temperatura. Los intercambiadores, serpentines o camisas, tienen un rendimiento mas alto al utilizar agua sobrecalentada, no hay que tratar el agua y no hay problemas de corrosión.

Su idoneidad depende de la temperatura objetivo, de la configuración de la planta y de la naturaleza del proceso. Por eso es importante estudiar no solo el punto de trabajo térmico, sino también el comportamiento dinámico de la instalación y sus necesidades de regulación.

Aceite térmico, una alternativa para altas temperaturas

El aceite térmico es una solución muy utilizada cuando el proceso necesita temperaturas elevadas hasta 350ºC sin recurrir a presiones tan altas como las que exigirían otros fluidos. Su principal valor reside en que permite trabajar con estabilidad en rangos térmicos altos, lo que lo convierte en una opción habitual en determinadas aplicaciones industriales continuas.

A cambio, requiere una gestión adecuada del circuito, del estado del fluido y del mantenimiento asociado. El comportamiento del aceite térmico depende de su calidad, de su degradación con el tiempo, los equipos térmicos eléctricos de fluido térmico, están diseñados para no modificar la calidad del aceite térmico y evitar los riesgos de autoignición. Por eso, aunque es una tecnología muy válida en ciertos escenarios, debe seleccionarse con criterio técnico el diseño de los equipos y con una visión clara del ciclo de vida de la instalación, los técnicos de ETE tienen una larga experiencia en la ingeniería de las instalaciones de aceite térmico y le asesoraran sobre el uso de estos equipos.

Definir bien el fluido térmico mejora todo el sistema

Elegir entre vapor, agua sobrecalentada y aceite térmico es una decisión que condiciona el rendimiento, la seguridad, la eficiencia y la escalabilidad de la instalación. No es solo una cuestión técnica, sino una palanca para optimizar el proceso en su conjunto.

Si tu empresa está valorando una nueva instalación térmica o revisando la actual, en ETE podemos ayudarte a comparar alternativas y definir la solución que mejor responda a tus necesidades productivas y energéticas.

El\u00a0vapor<\/strong>\u00a0ha sido hist\u00f3ricamente uno de los fluidos t\u00e9rmicos m\u00e1s utilizados en la industria. Su capacidad para transportar energ\u00eda y ceder calor de forma r\u00e1pida lo convierte en una soluci\u00f3n habitual en procesos donde se requiere\u00a0transferencia t\u00e9rmica<\/strong>, calentamiento indirecto o integraci\u00f3n con equipos ya dise\u00f1ados para trabajar con este medio.<\/p>

Sin embargo, trabajar con vapor tambi\u00e9n implica\u00a0tratar el agua,\u00a0gestionar\u00a0condensados, purgas<\/strong>\u00a0y un\u00a0mantenimiento\u00a0asociado\u00a0que debe estar bien resuelta para mantener la eficiencia del sistema.<\/p>

En proyectos donde ya existe red de vapor o donde el proceso requiere esta tecnolog\u00eda por sus caracter\u00edsticas, puede seguir siendo una opci\u00f3n v\u00e1lida. Aun as\u00ed, conviene estudiar si realmente es el medio m\u00e1s eficiente o si otras alternativas pueden ofrecer un\u00a0control m\u00e1s preciso<\/strong>\u00a0o una operaci\u00f3n m\u00e1s sencilla.

<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>","_padding":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":""},"_padding_tablet":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":"1"},"align_mobile":"center"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":""}],"isInner":""},{"id":"b6a6d51","elType":"section","settings":{"jet_parallax_layout_list":[],"structure":"22","raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"3396335"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"7473dfe"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"d16ec32"}],"gap":"wider","gap_columns_custom":{"unit":"px","size":0,"sizes":[]}},"elements":[{"id":"8568beb","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":66,"_inline_size":66.257999999999996,"raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"f149f54"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"05209c5"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"0e17e60"}],"padding":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[{"id":"18e1b29","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Qu\u00e9 aporta el agua sobrecalentada en procesos industriales","title_typography_typography":"custom","title_typography_font_size_mobile":{"unit":"px","size":"28","sizes":[]},"title_typography_text_transform":"uppercase","title_typography_font_size_tablet":{"unit":"px","size":"28","sizes":[]},"title_align_mobile":"center","raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"f346298"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"8e8923b"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"08e3ded"}]},"elements":[],"widgetType":"raven-heading"},{"id":"5eacbb6","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"

El\u00a0agua sobrecalentada<\/strong>\u00a0permite trabajar a temperaturas elevadas manteniendo el fluido en fase l\u00edquida gracias al uso de presi\u00f3n. Es una soluci\u00f3n muy interesante cuando se busca una\u00a0transferencia t\u00e9rmica eficiente<\/strong>, una distribuci\u00f3n estable del calor y una gesti\u00f3n m\u00e1s controlada del circuito.<\/p>

Frente al vapor, el agua sobrecalentada puede ofrecer ventajas en determinadas aplicaciones por su estabilidad y por la reducci\u00f3n de ciertas complejidades asociadas a la generaci\u00f3n y recuperaci\u00f3n de condensados. Adem\u00e1s, resulta adecuada en instalaciones donde se requiere una\u00a0distribuci\u00f3n uniforme del calor<\/strong>\u00a0en circuitos cerrados y un alto grado de control sobre la temperatura.\u00a0Los intercambiadores, serpentines o camisas, tienen un rendimiento mas alto al utilizar\u00a0agua sobrecalentada,\u00a0<\/strong>no hay que tratar el agua y no hay problemas de corrosi\u00f3n.<\/p>

Su idoneidad depende de la temperatura objetivo, de la configuraci\u00f3n de la planta y de la naturaleza del proceso. Por eso es importante estudiar no solo el punto de trabajo t\u00e9rmico, sino tambi\u00e9n el comportamiento din\u00e1mico de la instalaci\u00f3n y sus necesidades de regulaci\u00f3n.

<\/p>","_padding":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":""},"_padding_tablet":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":"1"},"align_mobile":"center"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false},{"id":"0238a60","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":33,"_inline_size":33.048000000000002,"raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"04312df"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"2b03a16"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"e3445f7"}],"margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[{"id":"b3f6a75","elType":"widget","settings":{"image":{"url":"https:\/\/ete.es\/wp-content\/uploads\/2021\/01\/caldera-vapor-210C.jpg","id":5901,"size":"","alt":"caldera-vapor-210C","source":"library"},"_margin_mobile":{"unit":"px","top":"10","right":"10","bottom":"10","left":"10","isLinked":true}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"image"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"322a47c","elType":"section","settings":{"jet_parallax_layout_list":[{"jet_parallax_layout_image":{"url":""},"_id":"1f0bc7f","jet_parallax_layout_speed":{"unit":"%","size":"50","sizes":[]},"jet_parallax_layout_bg_x":"50","jet_parallax_layout_bg_y":"50"}],"raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"e48e477"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"3baf3fa"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"e0caa8e"}],"margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":0,"bottom":"0","left":0,"isLinked":false}},"elements":[{"id":"9e9e630","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":"100","padding":{"unit":"px","top":"10","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":""},"padding_tablet":{"unit":"px","top":"10","right":"10","bottom":"10","left":"10","isLinked":"1"},"space_between_widgets":20,"raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"73ad55f"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"610cbe2"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"037cc25"}]},"elements":[{"id":"6fbf650","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Aceite temperaturas","title_typography_typography":"custom","title_typography_font_size_mobile":{"unit":"px","size":"28","sizes":[]},"title_typography_text_transform":"uppercase","title_typography_font_size_tablet":{"unit":"px","size":"28","sizes":[]},"title_align_mobile":"center","raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"f346298"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"8e8923b"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"08e3ded"}]},"elements":[],"widgetType":"raven-heading"},{"id":"97dc995","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"

El\u00a0aceite t\u00e9rmico<\/strong>\u00a0es una soluci\u00f3n muy utilizada cuando el proceso necesita\u00a0temperaturas elevadas<\/strong>\u00a0hasta 350\u00baC<\/strong>\u00a0sin recurrir a presiones tan altas como las que exigir\u00edan otros fluidos. Su principal valor reside en que permite trabajar con estabilidad en rangos t\u00e9rmicos altos, lo que lo convierte en una opci\u00f3n habitual en determinadas aplicaciones industriales continuas.<\/p>

A cambio, requiere una gesti\u00f3n adecuada del circuito, del estado del fluido y del mantenimiento asociado. El comportamiento del aceite t\u00e9rmico depende de su calidad, de su\u00a0degradaci\u00f3n con el tiempo<\/strong>, los equipos t\u00e9rmicos el\u00e9ctricos de fluido t\u00e9rmico, est\u00e1n dise\u00f1ados para no modificar la calidad del aceite t\u00e9rmico y evitar los riesgos de autoignici\u00f3n.\u00a0Por eso, aunque es una tecnolog\u00eda muy v\u00e1lida en ciertos escenarios, debe seleccionarse con\u00a0criterio t\u00e9cnico<\/strong>\u00a0<\/strong>el dise\u00f1o de los equipos\u00a0y con una visi\u00f3n clara del ciclo de vida de la instalaci\u00f3n, los t\u00e9cnicos de ETE tienen una larga experiencia en la ingenier\u00eda de las instalaciones de aceite t\u00e9rmico y le asesoraran sobre el uso de estos equipos.

item.title: Eficiencia y Descarbonización
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Eficiencia y Descarbonización

PIDE TU PRESUPUESTO

La eficiencia energética y la descarbonización se han convertido en dos prioridades estratégicas para la industria. Ya no se trata únicamente de reducir costes operativos, sino de adaptar los procesos productivos a un contexto en el que las emisiones, la electrificación y el uso responsable de la energía forman parte de la competitividad empresarial.

En este escenario, el calor industrial ocupa un papel central. Muchas instalaciones siguen dependiendo de sistemas basados en combustión para cubrir sus necesidades térmicas, a pesar de que existen alternativas capaces de ofrecer un control más preciso, una operación más limpia y una integración más coherente con los objetivos de sostenibilidad actuales.

En ETE llevamos décadas desarrollando soluciones de calor eléctrico industrial pensadas para responder a esa transformación. Fabricamos equipos robustos, diseñados a medida y orientados a mejorar el rendimiento térmico de los procesos, con una premisa clara: sustituir la combustión allí donde el calor eléctrico puede aportar una solución técnica más eficiente y alineada con la descarbonización.

Eficiencia energética en procesos térmicos industriales

Hablar de eficiencia en una instalación térmica no consiste solo en consumir menos. Significa utilizar la energía de forma precisa, estable y adaptada a la demanda real del proceso. Un sistema eficiente es aquel que genera el calor necesario en el momento adecuado, con el menor desperdicio posible y con una regulación capaz de mantener el rendimiento sin desviaciones innecesarias.

En muchos procesos industriales, la eficiencia se ve penalizada por sobredimensionamientos, pérdidas térmicas, inercias excesivas o sistemas de control poco ajustados. Por eso, el diseño del equipo y su integración en planta son tan importantes como la tecnología utilizada. En ETE hacemos un estudio de ingeniería para definir el equipo que necesitan nuestros clientes y fabricamos posteriormente el equipo con la tecnología segura fruto de muchos años de experiencia.

Las soluciones de calor eléctrico industrial permiten avanzar en este sentido gracias a su capacidad de respuesta, a la precisión en la modulación y a la ausencia de pérdidas asociadas a la combustión. Cuando el sistema está bien diseñado, la energía térmica se genera de forma más directa y controlable, lo que facilita optimizar el proceso y reducir incertidumbres operativas. El utilizar los equipos ETE de producción de calor, permite eliminar las grandes centrales térmicas de combustión e instalar un equipo junto a cada punto de consumo térmico.

 

Descarbonizar no es solo cambiar de energía

La descarbonización industrial suele asociarse a la sustitución de combustibles fósiles por fuentes eléctricas o renovables. Pero el cambio real va más allá. Implica revisar cómo se produce el calor, cómo se distribuye, cómo se controla y cómo se integra en la lógica productiva de la empresa.

Electrificar un proceso térmico no consiste en replicar exactamente una solución anterior con otra fuente de energía. Requiere rediseñar el sistema para aprovechar las ventajas de la tecnología de producir calor eléctrico: precisión, limpieza, simplicidad operativa y posibilidad de alinearse con estrategias energéticas de largo plazo. En ETE hablaran con tecnicos que tienen experiencia en producir color con electricidad y podrán dialogar para cambiar sus instalaciones y modernizarlas para que los procesos sean seguros y fiables.

En este sentido, la descarbonización bien planteada puede aportar beneficios que trascienden la reducción de emisiones directas. También mejora la trazabilidad energética, reduce ciertos costes de mantenimiento y facilita una operación más estable y automatizable. En el futuro podrán alimentar la electricidad a los equipos térmicos eléctricos ETE con instalaciones propias de energías renovables.

Preparar la industria para el siguiente paso

La transformación energética de la industria no se construye con soluciones genéricas. Requiere conocimiento técnico, capacidad de adaptación y una comprensión profunda del proceso. Si tu empresa está evaluando cómo mejorar la eficiencia de su sistema térmico o cómo avanzar en la descarbonización del calor industrial, en ETE podemos ayudarte a estudiar la viabilidad y diseñar una solución ajustada a tus necesidades.

La\u00a0eficiencia energ\u00e9tica<\/strong>\u00a0y la\u00a0descarbonizaci\u00f3n<\/strong>\u00a0se han convertido en dos prioridades estrat\u00e9gicas para la industria. Ya no se trata \u00fanicamente de reducir costes operativos, sino de adaptar los procesos productivos a un contexto en el que las emisiones, la electrificaci\u00f3n y el uso responsable de la energ\u00eda forman parte de la\u00a0competitividad empresarial<\/strong>.<\/p>

En este escenario, el calor industrial ocupa un papel central. Muchas instalaciones siguen dependiendo de sistemas basados en combusti\u00f3n para cubrir sus necesidades t\u00e9rmicas, a pesar de que existen alternativas capaces de ofrecer un\u00a0control m\u00e1s preciso<\/strong>, una operaci\u00f3n m\u00e1s limpia y una integraci\u00f3n m\u00e1s coherente con los objetivos de sostenibilidad actuales.<\/p>

En ETE llevamos d\u00e9cadas desarrollando\u00a0soluciones de calor el\u00e9ctrico industrial<\/strong>\u00a0pensadas para responder a esa transformaci\u00f3n. Fabricamos equipos robustos, dise\u00f1ados a medida y orientados a mejorar el rendimiento t\u00e9rmico de los procesos, con una premisa clara:\u00a0sustituir la combusti\u00f3n<\/strong>\u00a0all\u00ed donde el calor el\u00e9ctrico puede aportar una soluci\u00f3n t\u00e9cnica m\u00e1s eficiente y alineada con la descarbonizaci\u00f3n.<\/p>","_padding":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":""},"_padding_tablet":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":"1"},"align_mobile":"center"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"},{"id":"0684d61","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Eficiencia energ\u00e9tica en procesos t\u00e9rmicos industriales","title_typography_typography":"custom","title_typography_font_size_mobile":{"unit":"px","size":"28","sizes":[]},"title_typography_text_transform":"uppercase","title_typography_font_size_tablet":{"unit":"px","size":"28","sizes":[]},"title_align_mobile":"center","raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"f346298"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"8e8923b"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"08e3ded"}]},"elements":[],"widgetType":"raven-heading"},{"id":"2f36a18","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"

Hablar de eficiencia en una instalaci\u00f3n t\u00e9rmica no consiste solo en consumir menos. Significa utilizar la energ\u00eda de forma\u00a0precisa, estable y adaptada a la demanda real del proceso<\/strong>. Un sistema eficiente es aquel que genera el calor necesario en el momento adecuado, con el menor desperdicio posible y con una regulaci\u00f3n capaz de mantener el rendimiento sin desviaciones innecesarias.<\/p>

En muchos procesos industriales, la eficiencia se ve penalizada por\u00a0sobredimensionamientos<\/strong>, p\u00e9rdidas t\u00e9rmicas, inercias excesivas o sistemas de control poco ajustados. Por eso, el dise\u00f1o del equipo y su integraci\u00f3n en planta son tan importantes como la tecnolog\u00eda utilizada.\u00a0En ETE hacemos un estudio de ingenier\u00eda para definir el equipo que necesitan nuestros clientes y fabricamos posteriormente el equipo con la tecnolog\u00eda segura fruto de muchos a\u00f1os de experiencia.<\/p>

Las soluciones de\u00a0calor el\u00e9ctrico industrial<\/strong>\u00a0permiten avanzar en este sentido gracias a su capacidad de respuesta, a la precisi\u00f3n en la modulaci\u00f3n y a la ausencia de p\u00e9rdidas asociadas a la combusti\u00f3n. Cuando el sistema est\u00e1 bien dise\u00f1ado, la energ\u00eda t\u00e9rmica se genera de forma m\u00e1s directa y controlable, lo que facilita optimizar el proceso y reducir incertidumbres operativas.\u00a0El utilizar los equipos ETE de producci\u00f3n de calor, permite eliminar las grandes centrales t\u00e9rmicas de combusti\u00f3n e instalar un equipo junto a cada punto de consumo t\u00e9rmico.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>","_padding":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":""},"_padding_tablet":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":"1"},"align_mobile":"center"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":""}],"isInner":""},{"id":"b6a6d51","elType":"section","settings":{"jet_parallax_layout_list":[],"structure":"22","raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"3396335"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"7473dfe"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"d16ec32"}]},"elements":[{"id":"8568beb","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":66,"_inline_size":65.363,"raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"f149f54"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"05209c5"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"0e17e60"}],"padding":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":true}},"elements":[{"id":"18e1b29","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Descarbonizar no es solo cambiar de energ\u00eda","title_typography_typography":"custom","title_typography_font_size_mobile":{"unit":"px","size":"28","sizes":[]},"title_typography_text_transform":"uppercase","title_typography_font_size_tablet":{"unit":"px","size":"28","sizes":[]},"title_align_mobile":"center","raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"f346298"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"8e8923b"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"08e3ded"}]},"elements":[],"widgetType":"raven-heading"},{"id":"5eacbb6","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"

La\u00a0descarbonizaci\u00f3n industrial<\/strong>\u00a0suele asociarse a la sustituci\u00f3n de combustibles f\u00f3siles por fuentes el\u00e9ctricas o renovables. Pero el cambio real va m\u00e1s all\u00e1. Implica revisar c\u00f3mo se produce el calor, c\u00f3mo se distribuye, c\u00f3mo se controla y c\u00f3mo se integra en la l\u00f3gica productiva de la empresa.<\/p>

Electrificar un proceso t\u00e9rmico no consiste en replicar exactamente una soluci\u00f3n anterior con otra fuente de energ\u00eda. Requiere redise\u00f1ar el sistema para aprovechar las ventajas de\u00a0la tecnolog\u00eda de producir\u00a0calor el\u00e9ctrico<\/strong>: precisi\u00f3n, limpieza, simplicidad operativa y posibilidad de alinearse con estrategias energ\u00e9ticas de largo plazo.\u00a0En ETE hablaran con tecnicos que tienen experiencia en producir color con electricidad y podr\u00e1n dialogar para cambiar sus instalaciones y modernizarlas para que los procesos sean seguros y fiables.<\/p>

En este sentido, la descarbonizaci\u00f3n bien planteada puede aportar beneficios que trascienden la reducci\u00f3n de emisiones directas. Tambi\u00e9n mejora la\u00a0trazabilidad energ\u00e9tica<\/strong>, reduce ciertos costes de mantenimiento y facilita una operaci\u00f3n m\u00e1s estable y automatizable.\u00a0En el futuro podr\u00e1n alimentar la electricidad a los equipos t\u00e9rmicos el\u00e9ctricos ETE con instalaciones propias de energ\u00edas La transformaci\u00f3n energ\u00e9tica de la industria no se construye con soluciones gen\u00e9ricas. Requiere conocimiento t\u00e9cnico, capacidad de adaptaci\u00f3n y una comprensi\u00f3n profunda del proceso. Si tu empresa est\u00e1 evaluando c\u00f3mo mejorar la eficiencia de su sistema t\u00e9rmico o c\u00f3mo avanzar en la descarbonizaci\u00f3n del calor industrial<\/b>, en ETE podemos ayudarte a estudiar la viabilidad y dise\u00f1ar una soluci\u00f3n ajustada a tus necesidades<\/b>.<\/p>

Descubre cómo mejorar la eficiencia energética y avanzar en la descarbonización del calor industrial. Analizamos electrificación, control térmico, reducción de emisiones y soluciones de calor eléctrico para lograr procesos más limpios, estables y competitivos. ¡Solicite presupuesto!

item.title: Casos de Éxito
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Casos de Éxito

PIDE TU PRESUPUESTO

En el ámbito del calor industrial, la confianza se construye demostrando que una solución funciona en planta, responde con estabilidad a las exigencias del proceso y ofrece resultados medibles en términos de fiabilidad, control y eficiencia. Por eso, los casos de éxito tienen un valor especial: permiten comprobar cómo una tecnología se comporta en situaciones reales y qué impacto puede tener sobre la producción.

En ETE llevamos desde 1977 desarrollando soluciones de calor eléctrico industrial para aplicaciones muy diversas. A lo largo de estas décadas hemos trabajado con empresas que necesitaban resolver retos complejos relacionados con la generación de calor, la estabilidad del proceso, la electrificación de instalaciones y la sustitución de sistemas de combustión por alternativas más eficientes.

Más que proyectos, soluciones adaptadas a cada proceso

Cada caso de éxito parte de una necesidad concreta. En algunos proyectos, el objetivo principal ha sido mejorar el control térmico del proceso. En otros, reducir incertidumbres energéticas, eliminar emisiones directas en planta o adaptar una instalación a nuevas exigencias de producción. También hemos desarrollado soluciones para clientes que necesitaban equipos seguros, fabricados a medida y capaces de integrarse en entornos industriales con requerimientos muy específicos.

Lo que todos estos proyectos tienen en común es el enfoque técnico con el que se abordan. En ETE no partimos de una solución estándar que luego intentamos encajar. Analizamos cada aplicación, estudiamos las condiciones reales de operación y diseñamos el sistema térmico en función del uso final, del nivel de exigencia y de los objetivos energéticos del cliente.

Experiencia aplicada a nuevos retos industriales

La experiencia acumulada por ETE en múltiples proyectos es una ventaja para las empresas que buscan implantar soluciones térmicas con total seguridad. Haber trabajado en aplicaciones diversas nos permite anticipar necesidades, detectar variables críticas y proponer configuraciones más ajustadas desde las primeras fases del proyecto.

Ese conocimiento práctico resulta especialmente valioso cuando el cliente busca algo más que un equipo: busca una solución fiable, coherente con su proceso y preparada para evolucionar con la planta. Por eso, los casos de éxito no son solo una muestra de trabajos realizados, sino también una forma de demostrar nuestra manera de trabajar.

Un punto de partida para tu próximo proyecto

Si tu empresa está estudiando una instalación de calor industrial, una estrategia de electrificación o una mejora del rendimiento térmico del proceso, revisar casos de éxito puede ayudarte a entender mejor qué solución necesitas y qué resultados puedes esperar. En ETE ponemos esa experiencia al servicio de cada nuevo proyecto, con un enfoque técnico, realista y orientado al rendimiento.

Cada proceso tiene sus particularidades, pero la experiencia demuestra que cuando la solución está bien planteada desde el principio, los resultados llegan con mayor seguridad, eficiencia y continuidad operativa.

En estos 50 años de actividad, hemos estudiado y diseñado miles de equipos para procesos industriales, centrales nucleares, petroquímicas, industria alimentaria, industria plástica, farmacéuticas, hoteles, hospitales sistemas de calefacción centralizada en industrias y viviendas. En la actualidad las consultas que nos hacen de diversos procesos de calor, han sido estudiadas y hemos suministrado los equipos que funcionan durante decenas de años sin paradas ni mantenimiento.

Nuestro trabajo se basa en dos conceptos, trabajo de ingeniería para diseñar y calcular el equipo para cada caso y la tecnología para fabricar los equipos. Si ha recibido una propuesta nuestra, tiene que instalar nuestra tecnología, de lo contrario tendrá problemas con el servicio de calor en sus procesos.

item.title: Industrial Hot Water and DHW
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Industrial Hot Water and DHW

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we design and manufacture electric equipment for producing hot water with guaranteed service, optimized consumption and simple installation. In this category, we bring together our solutions for hotels, gyms, hair salons, residential communities, homes and other facilities that need reliable, tailor-made DHW.

Industrial hot water and DHW with ETE technology

Since 1977, we have been manufacturing electric heating equipment for industrial processes, collective installations and comfort services. When a facility needs domestic hot water in a stable way, with fast response times and without unnecessary complications, we design the most suitable ETE solution for each case.

We do not work with standard approaches for everyone. We study real consumption, simultaneity, the number of users, peak demand times, service temperature and the available space. With this data, we manufacture the equipment needed to guarantee the hot water service with the lowest possible energy cost within our working conditions.

DHW solutions for every type of facility

Within Industrial Hot Water and DHW, we bring together our solutions for different sectors and needs. Each subcategory responds to a specific use, but they all share the same technological base: electric heat production with robust equipment, easy to install and designed to work for years with minimal maintenance.

We work, among others, on the following applications:

  • Domestic Hot Water for Hotels, where we calculate the service according to the number of rooms, occupancy and shower usage profile.
  • Domestic Hot Water for Gyms, designed for changing rooms, collective showers and sports facilities with consumption concentrated in certain time slots.
  • Hot Water for Hair Salons, with compact and reliable equipment for washbasins and continuous consumption points.
  • Domestic Hot Water for Residential Communities, adapted to centralized installations that must ensure daily service for all users.
  • Heating for Industrial Warehouses and Premises, when, in addition to DHW, it is necessary to resolve the building’s general heating service.
  • Heating and Hot Water for Homes, for residential projects that require comfort, safety and low maintenance.

The same technology for very different sectors

Our Industrial Hot Water and DHW category allows us to respond to facilities with very different consumption profiles, but with one common requirement: having hot water available when it is needed, without failures and with a technically reasonable solution.

From a hotel with many rooms to a gym, a hair salon, a residential community or a home, we work with the same goal: to guarantee the service, reduce complexity and offer a durable thermal solution. And when the project also needs heating, we integrate both services so that the installation works as a coherent whole.

If you are studying a new installation or want to modernize an existing system, at ETE we calculate the necessary power and propose the most suitable solution for your DHW consumption or for your combined heating and hot water service. We manufacture custom-made equipment and help you define a simple, safe installation prepared to last.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What does the Industrial Hot Water and DHW category include?

It includes our solutions for producing domestic hot water in hotels, gyms, hair salons, residential communities, homes and other facilities where the service must be reliable, efficient and adapted to real consumption.

Do you manufacture custom-made equipment for each installation?

Yes. At ETE, we study each project and manufacture the solution with the power, storage capacity and configuration that each client needs to guarantee the hot water service.

Can you combine heating and DHW in the same solution?

Yes. When the project requires it, we design installations that integrate heating and hot water so that the system works in a coordinated way and with well-calculated power.

What advantages does an ETE electric solution have for producing DHW?

Our technology allows us to work with cleaner, simpler and safer installations, without combustion, without chimneys and with minimal maintenance, while keeping the focus on guaranteeing the service.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD

item.title: Domestic Hot Water for Residential Communities
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Domestic Hot Water for Residential Communities

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we design and manufacture domestic hot water equipment for residential communities that need a stable, efficient centralized service adapted to the building’s real consumption. Since 1977, we have been developing custom-made electric heat production equipment and, when we work for residential installations, we do so with a clear priority: to guarantee hot water every day with the lowest possible energy cost and with very low maintenance.

We do not approach DHW production for a residential community as a standard solution. We study the number of homes, the average number of people per home, consumption habits, the available space and the need for storage in order to define an installation capable of responding safely. That is why we guarantee the hot water service in writing and also calculate the expected consumption in kWh and in euros.

 

How we size a DHW installation for a residential community

To correctly define a centralized domestic hot water installation, we need to know the number of homes, average occupancy, estimated litres per person per day, service temperature and the conditions of the technical room. On ETE’s original page for shared DHW, for example, assumptions of 50 litres per person per day, a service temperature of 40 ºC and mains water at 10 ºC are used as a basis for calculating equipment and consumption.

This way of working avoids two common mistakes: falling short on service or oversizing the installation and assuming an unnecessary cost in equipment purchase and energy. Our goal is to adapt the solution to the reality of the building and guarantee the hot water service in writing. Installations are usually oversized.

 

Energy savings and consumption forecast

A homeowners community needs more than equipment capable of heating water. It also needs to know how much the installation may consume and how to optimize that cost with a well-calculated solution. At ETE, we deliver studies that make it possible to estimate consumption both in kWh and in euros, facilitating clearer decision-making for the property owners or for the maintenance company.

In addition, if the installation incorporates low-consumption shower heads, the equipment and energy cost can be reduced very significantly. This optimization is part of our technical approach from the first study.

 

Custom manufacturing and service guarantee

We manufacture the equipment, study the installation and propose the most suitable power according to the number of homes and the expected use. This allows us to achieve equipment with lower volume and power when the project allows it, with the resulting savings in investment and consumption.

Our DHW equipment is designed to work continuously, with simple installation, minimal maintenance and a long service life. In addition, we maintain ETE’s commitment to offering a 2-year guarantee and to backing the hot water service calculated for each project in writing. The materials we use give the equipment a service life of more than 20 years.

Send us the details of your residential community and we will study the most suitable DHW solution for your installation. We calculate the necessary power, define the storage capacity and propose ETE equipment designed to guarantee hot water with stability, controlled consumption and a long service life.

 

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What type of residential communities do we design these solutions for?

We work for residential communities with centralized DHW production, residential buildings, developments with several entrances and other properties that need a stable hot water service for multiple homes.

How do we calculate the necessary power for a residential community?

We start from the number of homes, the average number of people per home, the expected consumption, the service temperature, the mains water temperature and the available space. With this data, we define the most suitable power, storage capacity and configuration.

Can an old installation be replaced with ETE equipment?

Yes. We study the existing installation and propose a solution adapted to the technical room and the required service, seeking a clear, reliable implementation that is compatible with the reality of the building.

Is it possible to reduce energy consumption when renewing DHW production?

Yes. Well-sized equipment avoids oversizing, improves consumption control and makes it possible to better estimate monthly costs. In addition, certain saving measures at consumption points help to reduce energy demand even further.

What guarantee do our equipment units offer?

We maintain ETE’s commitment to a 2-year guarantee, simple installation and minimal maintenance, as well as a long service life thanks to the quality of the materials and the technical sizing of each project.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD

item.title: Domestic Hot Water for Gyms
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Domestic Hot Water for Gyms

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we design and manufacture domestic hot water equipment for gyms that need to respond to very intense peaks in consumption in changing rooms and showers. Since 1977, we have been developing custom-made electric heating equipment and, in sports facilities, our work focuses on one priority: guaranteeing hot water at times of maximum simultaneity without driving up energy costs.

We know that a gym does not consume DHW in a linear way. Demand is concentrated after classes, during certain times of the day and in specific changing room areas. That is why we calculate the installation according to the number of showers, users, usage habits and required service, in order to deliver robust, stable equipment adapted to the reality of the centre.

 

DHW for gyms with peak demand

In a gym, domestic hot water is put to the test in just a few minutes. It is common for many people to use the showers at the same time after a class or during certain shift changes. If the installation has not been properly designed, temperature drops, lack of service and user complaints appear.

At ETE, we solve this scenario with a technical approach adapted to the centre’s real use. We study the volume of users, the number of showers, the expected simultaneity and the gym’s daily routine in order to define a DHW installation capable of responding safely. Savings of 70% in equipment and in energy and water consumption are common with the installation designs we propose and the technology of our equipment.

 

How we calculate a hot water installation for a gym

To design a DHW solution for gyms, we need to know the centre’s expected attendance, the busiest usage times, the number of changing rooms, the available showers and the type of service to be guaranteed. With this data, we calculate the necessary power and the most suitable storage or production strategy.

This sizing is key to avoiding two frequent problems: equipment that falls short at peak times and oversized systems that increase costs without providing real value. Our way of working seeks a balance between service, investment and operating cost.

 

Robust equipment and minimal maintenance

A gym needs equipment that works every day without complicating the centre’s operations. We design robust electric heat solutions, with precise controls and a clear operating logic so that the DHW service remains stable for years.

Our approach avoids cumbersome solutions and focuses on useful technology: reliable equipment, long service life, well-resolved installation and very low maintenance compared with alternatives that generate more incidents and downtime.

Send us the details of your gym and we will study the DHW installation that best fits your changing rooms. We calculate the power, define the necessary production and propose ETE equipment designed to respond at peak times with controlled consumption.

 

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What type of gyms are our solutions suitable for?

We work for gyms, sports centres, boxes, clubs and other facilities with changing rooms and showers. We size each unit according to the volume of users and the simultaneity of use.

How do we calculate the necessary DHW power in a gym?

We need to know the expected attendance, peak times, the number of showers, the average usage time and the service to be guaranteed. With this data, we define the most suitable power and configuration.

What problem do we solve during peak times?

We design the installation to respond at times of maximum simultaneity, preventing the water from losing temperature or the service from being interrupted when several users shower at the same time.

Can energy costs be reduced when renewing the DHW system?

Yes. A well-sized and technologically updated installation helps to better control consumption, avoid oversizing and produce hot water with a more efficient response.

Do ETE units require a lot of maintenance?

No. We manufacture robust equipment designed to work continuously. We prioritize clear, reliable solutions with very low maintenance so that the gym does not have to devote resources to recurring incidents.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD

item.title: Domestic Hot Water for Hotels
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Domestic Hot Water for Hotels

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we design and manufacture domestic hot water equipment for hotels that need a stable, continuous service adapted to their real occupancy. Since 1977, we have been developing custom-made electric heating equipment and, when we work for the hotel sector, we do so with a clear priority: to guarantee hot water when the guest needs it and to control energy costs with maximum reliability.

We do not approach DHW production as a standard solution. We study rooms, occupancy peaks, consumption simultaneity, storage volume and installation conditions in order to size a system capable of responding safely. That is why we guarantee the hot water service in writing and propose robust equipment with very low maintenance.

 

DHW for hotels that cannot afford to fail

In a hotel, domestic hot water is a direct part of the customer experience. When the service does not respond, the problem is immediately perceived in rooms, showers and common-use areas. That is why at ETE we work with solutions aimed at guaranteeing continuity, comfort and peace of mind for the establishment’s technical management.

Our approach always starts from real use. An urban hotel with very regular occupancy is not the same as a holiday establishment with strong seasonal variations. We analyse each case to define the most suitable useful power, storage capacity and operating logic.

 

How we size a hot water installation for a hotel

To correctly define a DHW installation in a hotel, we need to know the number of rooms, expected occupancy, hours of maximum simultaneity, type of showers, daily consumption volume and available space in the technical room. With this information, we calculate the necessary production and design a custom-made solution.

This way of working avoids two very common mistakes: falling short on service or oversizing the equipment and paying more energy than necessary. Our goal is to adapt the installation to the reality of the hotel in order to guarantee stable hot water with a coherent investment.

 

Custom manufacturing and real technical support

We do not sell a generic boiler and then disengage. We manufacture the equipment, study the installation and deliver a technical proposal aligned with the needs of the project. This support is especially valuable in hotels looking to renovate old installations or modernise their DHW production without taking unnecessary risks.

Our technical approach is designed to last. We design robust equipment that is clear to operate and requires very little maintenance, because we know that a hotel needs continuity and no added complications in its day-to-day operations.

Send us the details of your hotel and we will study the most suitable DHW solution for your installation. We calculate the power, define the necessary storage capacity and propose ETE equipment designed to guarantee hot water with stability and controlled energy cost. We study both new and existing installations and provide the safest and most economical solution.

 

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What type of hotels can install our DHW solutions?

We work for both urban hotels and holiday establishments, hostels, aparthotels and accommodation facilities with significant hot water demand. We size each unit according to occupancy, number of rooms and consumption peaks.

How do we calculate the necessary power for a hotel?

We start from the real data of the installation: rooms, expected occupancy, shower simultaneity, consumption habits and available space. On this basis, we calculate the most suitable power, storage capacity and configuration to guarantee the service.

Can an old installation be modernised without redoing the entire technical room?

In many cases, yes. We study the existing installation and propose a solution adapted to the space, the required service and the hotel’s operation, seeking a clear and viable implementation.

What advantages does an ETE solution offer compared with other DHW systems?

Our advantage lies in custom sizing, the written guarantee of the hot water service, the reliability of the equipment and very low maintenance. We do not work with generic solutions, but with installations adapted to each project.

Does the equipment require a lot of maintenance?

No. We design our equipment to offer a long service life and operate with stability for years. We prioritise robust solutions, with simple operation and fewer incidents than other more complex systems.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD

item.title: Custom Hot Water Systems
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Custom Hot Water Systems

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we design and manufacture custom hot water systems for installations that need a solution adapted to their real consumption, available space and way of working. Since 1977, we have been developing electric heating equipment and our approach is always the same: to study each case, calculate the necessary power and guarantee in writing the hot water service that the installation needs.

We do not work with generic approaches. We analyse the number of users, consumption simultaneity, peak demand times, mains water temperature, service temperature and the possibility of incorporating storage. On this basis, we define a custom hot water system that responds with stability, requires minimal maintenance and helps to optimise energy costs.

 

A custom solution for every installation

There are installations that do not fit into a closed category. Some combine several consumption points, others have very marked peaks at certain times and others need to ensure continuous hot water throughout the day. For these projects, we develop custom hot water systems, adjusting production and storage to the client’s real demand.

We can size equipment for sanitary use installations, processes with high hot water consumption or projects where hot water needs to be combined with other thermal services. Our goal is to deliver a solution that works well from day one and maintains the service with maximum reliability.

 

 

Where we apply our custom hot water systems

This solution is designed for projects that need a personalised technical response and that do not always identify with a single sector. Among others, we can develop systems for:

  • Hotels and accommodation facilities with variable occupancy profiles.
  • Gyms, sports centres and changing rooms with shower peaks during rush hours.
  • Hair salons, beauty centres and businesses with repeated consumption throughout the day.
  • Residential communities and collective installations with centralised service.
  • Industrial processes or special installations that need hot water production adapted to their working conditions.

Although each project is different, they all share the same working criterion: correctly calculating the installation to guarantee the service and avoid both lack of capacity and unnecessary oversizing.

 

Advantages of working with ETE

  • We have been manufacturing electric heating equipment since 1977.
  • We guarantee in writing the hot water service that the installation needs.
  • We size each project using real usage and consumption data.
  • We design solutions with simple installation and reduced maintenance.
  • We work with robust equipment, long service life and stable response.

Our technology allows us to better adjust the power and volume of the system, which can translate into savings both in the initial investment and in energy consumption, always without compromising the quality of the service.

Savings of more than 70% in the purchase of equipment and hot water consumption are common with our designs and the technology of our equipment.

Tell us about the needs of your installation. At ETE, we calculate the necessary power, propose the most suitable configuration and indicate the hot water solution that best adapts to your project.

 

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What does it mean for a hot water system to be custom-made?

It means that we do not simply start from a standard unit. At ETE, we study the real demand, simultaneity, available space and service temperature in order to define the power, storage and configuration that each installation needs.

What types of installations do you design these solutions for?

We can develop custom systems for hotels, gyms, hair salons, residential communities, collective installations and other projects with specific domestic hot water or process hot water needs.

How do you calculate the necessary power?

We take the real data of the installation and assess users, flow rates, peak demand times, mains water temperature and service temperature. With this information, we size the system to guarantee the service in writing.

Can the equipment be adapted to the available space?

Yes. One of the objectives of our work is to adapt the implementation to the technical room or available area so that the installation is as simple, orderly and efficient as possible.

What advantages does an ETE solution offer compared with a generic option?

Our difference lies in the prior technical calculation, in manufacturing adapted to the project, in the reliability of the equipment and in the focus on guaranteeing service and optimising energy costs without oversizing the installation.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD

At ETE, we design and manufacture custom hot water systems for installations that need a solution adapted to their real consumption<\/strong>, available space and way of working. Since 1977, we have been developing electric heating equipment and our approach is always the same: to study each case, calculate the necessary power and guarantee in writing the hot water service that the installation needs.<\/p>

We do not work with generic approaches. We analyse the number of users, consumption simultaneity, peak demand times, mains water temperature, service temperature and the possibility of incorporating storage. On this basis, we define a custom hot water system that responds with stability, requires minimal maintenance and helps to optimise energy costs.<\/p>

Some combine several consumption points, others have very marked peaks at certain times and others need to ensure continuous hot water throughout the day. For these projects, we develop custom hot water systems, adjusting production and storage to the client\u2019s real demand.<\/strong><\/p>

We can size equipment for sanitary use installations, processes with high hot water consumption or projects where hot water needs to be combined with other thermal services. Our goal is to deliver a solution that works well from day one and maintains the service with maximum reliability.<\/p>

This solution is designed for projects that need a personalised technical response<\/strong> and that do not always identify with a single sector. Among others, we can develop systems for:<\/p>

  • Hotels<\/strong> and accommodation facilities with variable occupancy profiles.<\/li>
  • Gyms<\/strong>, sports centres and changing rooms with shower peaks during rush hours.<\/li>
  • Hair salons<\/strong>, beauty centres and businesses with repeated consumption throughout the day.<\/li>
  • Residential communities<\/strong> and collective installations with centralised service.<\/li>
  • Industrial processes<\/strong> or special installations that need hot water production adapted to their working conditions.<\/li><\/ul>

    Although each project is different, they all share the same working criterion: correctly calculating the installation to guarantee the service and avoid both lack of capacity and unnecessary oversizing.<\/p>

item.title: Turkish Bath, Hammam and Passive Sweating
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Turkish Bath, Hammam and Passive Sweating

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we design and manufacture custom-made equipment for Turkish baths, hammams and passive sweating systems for thermal spas, spas, hotels, wellness centres and thermalism projects. We work so that each installation offers a comfortable, healthy and profitable experience, with the exact climate it needs and with consumption adapted to the real use of the space.

When a client is looking for a steam or moist heat solution to produce passive sweating, we have the best system available. They need an installation that works steadily, maintains the expected temperature and humidity, is easy to maintain and fits the wellness experience they want to offer. At ETE, we start from that criterion and manufacture equipment designed to provide service for years, with reliability and a long service life.

 

We manufacture custom-made solutions for steam, humidity and sweating

Every Turkish bath, Roman bath, hammam or passive sweating project requires a specific technical study. Climate-controlling a small space for individual use is not the same as climate-controlling a high-rotation steam room in a hotel or a thermalism area inside a thermal spa. That is why we analyse the volume of the room, the insulation, the frequency of use, the type of covering, the heating time and the environmental conditions that must be maintained during service.

Our work is not limited to selling standard equipment. At ETE, we calculate the necessary power, recommend the most suitable solution and guarantee in writing the heat or steam service that the installation needs. This approach allows us to optimise the initial investment, reduce unnecessary consumption and avoid oversizing that increases the cost of purchasing, installing and operating the centre on a daily basis.

 

Our solutions for Turkish baths, hammams and passive sweating

Within this line of work, we develop different equipment and configurations to cover complementary experiences within the same wellness or thermal area:

Equipment for Turkish Baths

We manufacture steam generators for Turkish baths with the right power for each room. ETE’s accumulated experience in this type of installation allows us to recommend the ideal equipment for each volume, avoiding excess power and improving user comfort. Our equipment is designed to work with minimal breakdowns, easy maintenance and a stable response in steam production. In addition, we advise on the ideal construction of the room to save energy and improve the final result.

Wet Sauna - Roman Bath

The wet sauna we develop at ETE is aimed at passive sweating through a mild and controlled climate. Compared with other more aggressive solutions, this proposal seeks a deep feeling of relaxation with balanced temperatures and humidity. It is a highly valued installation in spas, thermal spas, hotels and clinics because it helps create a comfortable and repeatable wellness experience, with an environment that favours relaxation and recovery.

Mitermal Wet Sauna

We also work with Mitermal solutions for projects that need a compact and efficient version of passive sweating. It is a very interesting alternative when the aim is to make better use of the available space or when the project requires a simple installation, with low maintenance and easy integration. At ETE, we advise on the best way to implement this type of equipment so that the final experience is comfortable, safe and profitable.

Barros Lodarium

The Lodarium expands the wellness circuit with mud, clay, algae and cream treatments within an environment of controlled temperature and humidity. In this type of installation, we combine the right climate control unit to create the working environment with bi-thermal showers and other elements that complete the usage protocol. It is an especially interesting solution for thermal spas and spas that want to enrich their offer with differentiated treatments of high perceived value.

 

A category designed for spas, thermal spas, hammams and wellness hotels

We work both for new installations and for extensions or refurbishments. We can intervene in complete spa and thermal spa projects, in wet areas inside hotels, in urban wellness centres, in clinics or in thermalism spaces where the aim is to offer a combination of steam, moist heat and body treatments.

Our goal is for each installation to be profitable in the long term and to improve customers’ health. To achieve this, we study the project from a technical point of view and also from the point of view of the user experience: operating times, customer rotation, target temperature, maintenance, integration with other areas of the circuit and ease of daily operation.

Tell us what type of Turkish bath, Roman bath, hammam or passive sweating system you want to install. At ETE, we will study your project and recommend the most suitable solution for the space, the service and the planned budget. We design and manufacture custom-made equipment so that your installation works as it should from day one.

 

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What solutions does ETE include within Turkish baths, hammams and passive sweating?

In this category, we work with equipment for Turkish baths, wet saunas, Mitermal wet saunas and Barros Lodarium. They are complementary solutions for creating steam, moist heat, passive sweating and body treatment experiences within spas, thermal spas, hotels and wellness centres.

Can you manufacture a custom-made hammam or Turkish bath?

Yes. At ETE, we work on a custom-made basis. We study the volume of the room, insulation, user rotation, heating time and the level of humidity or steam that the room must maintain in order to recommend the most suitable equipment and configuration.

What is the advantage of correctly sizing the equipment power?

Correctly sizing the power makes it possible to avoid extra purchase costs, reduce unnecessary consumption and achieve more stable operation. At ETE, we calculate the power according to the real use of the installation in order to guarantee the service with the highest possible efficiency.

Do you also advise on the construction of the room?

Yes. In addition to manufacturing the equipment, at ETE we advise on the construction conditions that help improve comfort, reduce energy losses and ensure that the Turkish bath, wet sauna or Lodarium works under the right conditions.

Is it possible to combine several experiences in the same wellness area?

Yes. We can integrate different steam, passive sweating and complementary treatment solutions into the same project to create more complete and attractive thermal circuits for the end user.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD

item.title: Spa Showers and Contrast Circuits
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Spa Showers and Contrast Circuits

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we design and manufacture custom-made spa showers and contrast circuits for thermal spas, hotels, wellness centres and thermal areas that need to offer a well-resolved, safe and durable water experience. We do not simply sell an isolated piece of equipment. We study the project, calculate the installation and manufacture the solution that best fits the thermal route, the type of user, the available space and the service that each centre wants to provide.

Our experience in heat production with electricity and in manufacturing technical equipment for spas since 1979 allows us to integrate hot water, cold water, thermal contrasts, usage sequences, timing and different sensations within the same installation.


We manufacture spa showers designed for the centre’s real use

Each project has different needs. Some spas need to reinforce the thermal contrast area with Scottish showers, buckets or cold-water tunnels. Others prioritise more sensory routes, with mist water, bithermal applications or showers with oils. There are also installations where the main objective is to guarantee the hot water service, correctly regulate usage times or incorporate specific solutions for hygiene and starting the circuit.

That is why at ETE we work from a custom manufacturing logic. We define the water temperature, the type of application, the intensity of the effect, the control system and the integration with the rest of the equipment in the installation.

 

What solutions we group within this category

Within Spa Showers and Contrast Circuits, we bring together different ETE solutions to cover the complete water route, thermal contrast and the sensory spa experience:

Hot water for showers

We design and manufacture systems to guarantee the hot water service at 40 ºC in spa showers, with the necessary power to respond to the centre’s real occupancy and the expected pace of use.

Bithermal Scottish shower hot 40 ºC cold 6 ºC

It alternates hot water and cold water to stimulate circulation and generate an intense, controlled thermal effect.

Bithermal shower with oils

We integrate temperature contrast with aromatic applications to enrich the user experience and add an additional sensory dimension to the wellness route.

Bucket shower

A classic solution to create an immediate cold-water impact after a sauna, steam bath or heat area.

Disinfection shower

We incorporate showers designed to reinforce hygiene protocols and prepare the user before entering certain areas of the circuit.

Start shower

Designed to introduce the user into the route progressively, preparing the body for the rest of the thermal and sensory stimuli of the installation.

Mist shower

It generates a soft, enveloping application, very suitable for moments of relaxation, transition between spaces or more delicate sensory experiences.

Timed shower

It allows usage time to be controlled, rationalises consumption and provides operational order in installations with high user turnover.

Large shower

We develop larger-format shower solutions to create a more enveloping effect and a prominent presence within the spa circuit.

Cold-water tunnel 6 ºC

A particularly interesting alternative when the aim is to create a contrast passage with cold water as the main element and an immersive route experience.

Bithermal tunnel

It combines different temperatures within a passage format that intensifies the sensation of thermal contrast and adds dynamism to the circuit.

Bithermal Vichy

An application focused on wellness and treatment through distributed jets, with controlled thermal contrast and a clearly experiential approach.

Custom manufacturing for thermal spas, hotels and wellness centres

We work on new projects, refurbishments and extensions. We can intervene in hotel spas, thermal spas, wellness centres, thermal facilities, gyms with wellness areas and spaces that need to reinforce their contrast circuit with reliable and well-integrated technical solutions.

If you are designing a new shower area or want to renovate an existing installation, at ETE we help you define what equipment you need, how it should work and which configuration best fits your project.

Tell us the characteristics of your spa, the type of circuit you want to build and the hot water, cold water or thermal contrast needs of your installation. Our technical team will study the project and propose a custom-made ETE solution, designed to offer service, durability and a high-level user experience.

 

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What is the difference between a spa shower and a contrast circuit?

A spa shower can respond to a specific function within the installation, while a contrast circuit combines several water and temperature applications to create a complete route for activation, relaxation and recovery. At ETE, we design both approaches and adapt them to the project.

Can you manufacture custom-made spa showers?

Yes. At ETE, we work on a custom-made basis. We study the type of centre, the available space, the experience to be offered and the service needs in order to define the most suitable solution.

What equipment can be integrated into this category?

Within this category, we bring together solutions such as hot water for showers, bithermal Scottish shower, bithermal shower with oils, bucket shower, disinfection shower, start shower, mist shower, timed shower, large shower, cold-water tunnel, bithermal tunnel and bithermal Vichy.

Do you also calculate the hot water and cold water for the circuit?

Yes. We do not only manufacture the visible equipment. We also study hot water production, the need for cold water and the technical integration of the whole system so that the circuit works with stability and a guaranteed service.

What type of installations do you work for?

We work for thermal spas, hotel spas, wellness centres, thermal facilities and other projects that want to incorporate or renovate shower routes and thermal contrast circuits.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD

item.title: Technical Equipment for Spas and Thermal Spas
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Technical Equipment for Spas and Thermal Spas

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we manufacture technical equipment for spas designed to support the real operation of a thermal spa, a spa hotel, a wellness centre or a thermal area. These are solutions that are not always perceived at first glance as the most experiential element of the circuit, but they are decisive for the installation to respond with stability, efficiency and comfort.

When a wellness project needs cold or heat for pools, equipment to produce passive sweating, heating and cooling equipment for showers, controlled ventilation to keep the air in good condition or bithermal and collective showers with rational water consumption, the technical part ceases to be secondary support and becomes the basis of the service.

That is why at ETE we design this line of equipment so that each installation works as it should and adapts to the specific needs of each centre.

 

The technical foundation that makes a well-resolved spa possible

In a spa, it is not enough to have pools, showers or sweating areas. It is also essential to control the water temperature when thermal contrasts are required, maintain adequate ventilation to preserve the quality of the environment and resolve shower services with efficient consumption.

Our experience allows us to study each project from a global perspective. We analyse what performance the installation needs, how each piece of equipment should be integrated and what conditions of use the centre will have in order to propose a reliable, durable technical solution sized to measure.

 

Our solutions in technical equipment for spas

Within this category, we group three product lines that perform key functions within the spa:

Etecooler Chiller

We manufacture the Etecooler Chiller for applications where the spa needs to work with chilled water in a stable way. It is a solution especially suitable for toning pools at 10 °C and for bithermal showers with water at 8 °C, two common services in contrast circuits and hydrotherapy.

Our goal is for the centre to have the necessary level of cold continuously, safely and with correct integration within the rest of the water circuit. This ensures that thermal contrast becomes a real part of the experience and does not depend on improvised solutions.

Air Treatment Equipment

At ETE, we also manufacture air treatment equipment for forced ventilation in residential and commercial applications, especially useful in wellness installations where air renewal and energy control are decisive.

Our equipment incorporates a static aluminium exchanger and makes it possible to save more than 50% of the thermal energy of the premises that would otherwise be lost with the expelled stale air. In addition, it is available in 10 sizes for air volumes between 300 and 6,800 m³/h, and can be installed in a suspended ceiling or ducted for air supply and extraction from the environment.

Timed Mixer

The Timed Mixer is a practical solution for collective shower areas where the aim is to offer good service to the user and, at the same time, reduce water and energy consumption. We manufacture it for installations that need usage control, savings and simple operation.

It is an especially useful piece of equipment in changing rooms, spas, gyms, thermal spas and other shared spaces where the efficiency of the installation is as important as the comfort of the end user. With this type of solution, we help reduce consumption, optimise power and adjust the necessary storage volume.

We design each project to measure

We do not treat this equipment as isolated pieces. At ETE, we study how the installation should work as a whole, what relationship exists between heat or cold production, ventilation of the premises, the centre’s expected use and the experience to be offered to the user.

We can intervene in new projects as well as in extensions, refurbishments or the replacement of existing equipment. Our technical-commercial department analyses the case and proposes the solution that best fits the available space, the intensity of use and the objectives of the project.

 

Manufacturing for spas, thermal spas and hotels

We work for urban spas, hotels with wellness areas, thermal spas, thermal centres, thalasso centres and projects that need to resolve the technical part of the circuit with reliable and well-sized equipment. We began designing thermalism centres and specific equipment in 1979 and, for more than 20 years, we have been the only manufacturer in the market. The centres we collaborate with are very profitable and have very good thermal installations.

If you are defining a new installation or want to improve an existing one, at ETE we will help you select the right solution to chill water, ventilate the environment or rationalise shower consumption. We manufacture the equipment your project needs and support you during the definition process.

Tell us what type of spa you are designing or what technical need you want to solve. At ETE, we will study the project with you in order to propose the most suitable equipment according to flow rates, temperatures, ventilation, expected use and efficiency objectives.

 

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What does the technical equipment for spas category include?

It includes key technical solutions for the operation of the spa, such as the Etecooler Chiller, the Air Treatment Equipment and the Timed Mixer. They are pieces of equipment aimed at controlling water, air and consumption in collective-use areas.

What is an Etecooler Chiller used for in a spa?

It is used to provide chilled water in a stable way in applications such as toning pools or bithermal showers. It is a fundamental piece when the project incorporates thermal contrast circuits and hydrotherapy.

Does the air treatment equipment help save energy?

Yes. Our air treatment equipment is designed for forced ventilation with energy recovery, which helps reduce thermal losses and improve the efficiency of the installation as a whole.

Is the Timed Mixer suitable for collective showers?

Yes. It is a very useful solution for shared-use showers because it allows good service to be offered while controlling water and energy consumption.

Can you size this equipment according to the needs of each project?

Yes. At ETE, we study each case individually to select the most suitable equipment according to the type of centre, air volume, working temperatures, intensity of use and installation conditions.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD

\u00a0<\/p>","_padding":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":""},"_padding_tablet":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"0","left":"0","isLinked":"1"},"align_mobile":"center"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"},{"id":"0684d61","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"The technical foundation that makes a well-resolved spa possible","title_typography_typography":"custom","title_typography_font_size_mobile":{"unit":"px","size":"28","sizes":[]},"title_typography_text_transform":"uppercase","title_typography_font_size_tablet":{"unit":"px","size":"28","sizes":[]},"title_align_mobile":"center","raven_animated_gradient_color_list":[{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F6AD1F","_id":"f346298"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#F7496A","_id":"8e8923b"},{"raven_animated_gradient_color":"#565AD8","_id":"08e3ded"}]},"elements":[],"widgetType":"raven-heading"},{"id":"2f36a18","elType":"widget","settings":{"editor":"

In a spa, it is not enough to have pools, showers or sweating areas. It is also essential to control the water temperature when thermal contrasts are required,<\/strong> maintain adequate ventilation to preserve the quality of the environment and resolve shower services with efficient consumption.<\/p>

Our experience allows us to study each project from a global perspective. We analyse what performance the installation needs, how each piece of equipment should be integrated and what conditions of use the centre will have in order to propose a reliable, durable technical solution sized to measure.<\/p>

Within this category, we group three product lines that perform key functions within the spa:<\/p>

Etecooler Chiller<\/strong><\/p>

We manufacture the Etecooler Chiller for applications where the spa needs to work with chilled water in a stable way. It is a solution especially suitable for toning pools at 10 \u00b0C and for bithermal showers with water at 8 \u00b0C, two common services in contrast circuits and hydrotherapy.<\/p>

Our goal is for the centre to have the necessary level of cold continuously, safely and with correct integration within the rest of the water circuit. This ensures that thermal contrast becomes a real part of the experience and does not depend on improvised solutions.<\/p>

Air Treatment Equipment<\/strong><\/p>

At ETE, we also manufacture air treatment equipment for forced ventilation in residential and commercial applications, especially useful in wellness installations where air renewal and energy control are decisive.<\/p>

Our equipment incorporates a static aluminium exchanger and makes it possible to save more than 50% of the thermal energy of the premises that would otherwise be lost with the expelled stale air. In addition, it is available in 10 sizes for air volumes between 300 and 6,800 m\u00b3\/h, and can be installed in a suspended ceiling or ducted for air supply and extraction from the environment.<\/p>

Timed Mixer<\/strong><\/p>

The Timed Mixer is a practical solution for collective shower areas where the aim is to offer good service to the user and, at the same time, reduce water and energy consumption. We manufacture it for installations that need usage control, savings and simple operation.<\/p>

It is an especially useful piece of equipment in changing rooms, spas, gyms, thermal spas and other shared spaces where the efficiency of the installation is as important as the comfort of the end user. With this type of solution, we help reduce consumption, optimise power and adjust the necessary storage volume.<\/p>

We design each project to measure<\/strong><\/p>

We do not treat this equipment as isolated pieces. At ETE, we study how the installation should work as a whole, what relationship exists between heat or cold production, ventilation of the premises, the centre\u2019s expected use and the experience to be offered to the user.<\/p>

We can intervene in new projects as well<\/strong> as in extensions, refurbishments or the replacement of existing equipment. Our technical-commercial department analyses the case and proposes the solution that best fits the available space, the intensity of use and the objectives of the project.<\/p>
