item.title: Equipment for Hot Yoga and Bikram Studios
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Equipment for Hot Yoga and Bikram Studios

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we design custom-made equipment for Hot Yoga studios. We do not simply supply separate machines. We study each project so that the exercise room, air quality and shower service work as a stable, profitable and easy-to-manage system in day-to-day operation.

Our experience in electric heat production dates back to 1977, and this background allows us to approach a Hot Yoga studio from a complete technical perspective. We analyse the square metres of the room, the height, the insulation level, the number of students per class, the daily rotation, the use of changing rooms and the demand for hot water. From there, we calculate the combination of equipment that best responds to your project.

 

A comprehensive solution so that your studio works well from day one

In a Hot Yoga centre, the room environment is part of the service itself. That is why we design installations capable of maintaining a high temperature, balanced humidity and clean air, even when occupancy is high and activity is intense. The objective is not only to heat the premises, but to create constant conditions so that the practice is comfortable, safe and professional.

To this climate control and air treatment area, we add the hot water service for showers and, when the project requires it, solutions to cool the water and complete the student’s experience after class. In this way, the studio does not depend on improvised systems or different suppliers for each need. Everything is planned with a single technical logic.

 

Equipment calculated according to the reality of each centre

No two studios are the same. There are newly opened premises, renovated spaces inside gyms, rooms with high ceilings, centres with many consecutive classes and others with usage peaks concentrated in certain time slots. That is why we do not work with generic solutions. At ETE, we calculate the necessary power, the type of equipment and the form of integration so that the installation responds to the centre’s real load.

When we propose equipment for Hot Yoga, we seek to help the promoter better control their fixed and variable costs. A well-sized project avoids unnecessary excess power, improves service stability and reduces operational incidents. It also helps students perceive a more carefully resolved experience: a uniform room, breathable air, available showers and an overall feeling of technical comfort.

 

We manufacture custom-made equipment for new centres and operating studios

We can study the complete installation of a newly opened studio or intervene in centres that are already operating and need to improve climate control, ventilation or hot water. In both cases, we start from specific data to offer a solution adapted to the real use of the business.

If you are thinking of opening, refurbishing or optimising a Hot Yoga studio, at ETE we help you size the project with custom-made electric equipment and service guarantee. Our goal is for the installation to respond well every day and for the centre to gain in comfort, image and profitability.

 

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What do our equipment units for Hot Yoga studios include?

They include the room’s climate control, air cleaning and renewal, and the hot water service for showers. Depending on the project, we can also integrate timed showers and cold-water solutions for contrast.

Do we only work for new studios?

No. At ETE, we study both new openings and refurbishments or improvements in centres that are already operating and want to optimise consumption, comfort or air quality.

Why do we manufacture the solution to measure?

Because the performance of a Hot Yoga studio depends on specific variables such as surface area, height, capacity, class frequency and use of changing rooms. A well-calculated installation provides better service and avoids extra costs.

Can we advise your installer or technical team?

Yes. Our technicians advise on the installation and provide hydraulic, electrical and ventilation diagrams so that the project is carried out with a clear technical basis.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD

item.title: Ventilation and Air Quality
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Ventilation and Air Quality

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we design ventilation and air quality for Hot Yoga rooms as an essential part of the project. In these spaces, temperature is not the only thing that matters. It is also essential for the air to remain clean, breathable and balanced throughout the entire class, even when occupancy is high and physical activity quickly increases the environmental load of the room.

Our experience has shown us that a room can be hot and yet not offer a good feeling to the student if ventilation is not properly resolved. Excess CO2, stale air and the accumulation of odours make the practice less comfortable and lower the overall perception of the centre, even when other parameters seem correct.

 

Clean air for a healthier practice

In our Hot Yoga line, we work with solutions aimed at cleaning the air, reducing the CO2 generated by people as they breathe and maintaining the environmental balance inside the room. This point is decisive in classes with many students, where ventilation must act without breaking the thermal stability or unbalancing the humidity.

That is why we do not approach ventilation as a simple intake of outdoor air. We study it as an integrated system with the climate control, capable of renewing the environment with technical criteria and maintaining an air quality suited to the centre’s real use. This improves breathing, reduces odours and creates a feeling of cleanliness that the student perceives from the very first moment.

 

Ventilation designed for rooms with high occupancy

A Hot Yoga studio works under very demanding conditions: high temperature, controlled humidity, intense occupancy and consecutive sessions. All this requires precise calculation of the air flow rate, the form of renewal and the relationship between ventilation, heat and humidity. If one of these elements fails, the whole system is affected.

At ETE, we study the surface area of the premises, the height, the number of users, the pace of classes and the room configuration in order to propose the right solution. Our goal is for the air to remain clean without creating uncomfortable draughts or unnecessary energy losses.

What good air quality improves

• Reduces the feeling of stale air during practice.

• Helps control CO2 in rooms with high occupancy.

• Improves the perception of cleanliness and professionalism of the centre.

• Helps balance temperature and humidity inside the room.

• Promotes a more comfortable experience that is easier to repeat.

 

At ETE, we design custom-made solutions for every room

We can study ventilation and air quality both for a new room and for a centre that is already open and needs to improve its indoor environment.

We analyse the project, size the solution and advise on the installation so that the room gains in clean air, stability and comfort. The installations we design create the perfect climate for the practice of Hot Yoga Bikram and have an energy consumption of around €2 to maintain humidity, heat and clean air in a 120 m² room.

If you need to improve the air in your Hot Yoga studio, at ETE we help you design a custom-made solution to reduce CO2, correctly renew the environment and keep the room prepared for a demanding and professional practice.

 

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Why is ventilation so important in Hot Yoga?

Because in a room with high temperature and many students, the air can become stale very quickly. Good ventilation helps control CO2, reduce odours and improve the feeling of cleanliness and comfort.

Should ventilation be integrated with climate control?

Yes. At ETE, we approach it as part of the same system so that air renewal does not break the thermal stability or unbalance the humidity of the room.

Can we improve an existing installation?

Yes. We can study operating centres that need to improve air quality, comfort or environmental balance without redoing the entire project from scratch.

What data do we need to study the solution?

We need to know the surface area, the height of the room, the capacity, the frequency of classes and the general characteristics of the premises in order to calculate the most suitable ventilation.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD

item.title: Thermal Solutions for Bakeries
item.dc:creator: morgan-admin
item.content:encoded:
Thermal Solutions for Bakeries

REQUEST YOUR QUOTE

At ETE, we manufacture thermal solutions for bakeries aimed at improving bread quality, stabilising processes and reducing incidents in daily production. Since 1977, we have been developing electric heating equipment and, within the bakery sector, we have spent decades working on two needs that remain decisive in any bakery workshop: well-controlled fermentation and a clean steam supply that improves the final result of the bread without damaging the ovens.

Our work does not consist of selling a standard machine and ending there. We study each client’s process, calculate the power they need, define the temperature and working conditions of the equipment and guarantee the heat service in writing. This approach allows us to offer durable, stable and adapted solutions for both artisan bakeries and bakeries with continuous production.

 

We design the custom-made thermal solution for each bakery

Not all bakeries work in the same way. There are artisan bakeries with more gradual rhythms, bakeries that combine bread and pastry, intensive productions with several shifts and spaces with very specific installation limitations. That is why we do not approach thermal solutions as a closed product, but as a custom-made technical service.

When a client explains their process to us, we analyse what they need at each stage: production volume, type of ovens, chamber dimensions, working temperatures, schedules and quality objectives. With this information, we calculate the power, performance and most suitable configuration. This way, we ensure that the equipment adapts to the bakery and not the other way round.

 

Technology to save energy and work with stability

A well-sized thermal solution not only improves the final product; it also helps to work more efficiently. When fermentation is correct, when the steam supply responds well and when the system is designed for the real demand of the bakery, imbalances are reduced, excess consumption is avoided and production stability is gained.

At ETE, we support useful technology, not cumbersome technology. We manufacture robust electric heating equipment, with precise controls and an approach designed to last for many years. Our goal is for the bakery to have a reliable solution that works continuously, without recurring breakdowns or hidden maintenance costs.

A technical supplier for artisan and industrial bakeries

We work with bakeries that seek to improve the quality of their bread, optimise fermentation, achieve cleaner steam or renew installations that no longer respond as they should. In all cases, we start from the same idea: listening to the client’s real process and offering a specific, viable and durable response.

If you are considering improving the fermentation of your doughs, incorporating clean steam into ovens or reviewing the thermal approach of your bakery, at ETE we can help you. We manufacture our own equipment, study every technical need and propose a solution designed so that you can make the best bread in your area and remain stable for years.

Send us the details of your process and we will study the most suitable thermal solution for your bakery. We calculate the power, define the heat service and propose ETE equipment sized for your production.

 

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What type of thermal solutions can we install in a bakery?

We can help you resolve the two most common needs in bakery production: controlled fermentation of doughs and clean steam supply for ovens and steam generators. From there, we study each case and define the most suitable solution according to production and the available space.

Are our units suitable for any type of bakery?

Yes. We work for both artisan bakeries and bakeries with greater production capacity. We size the installation according to the volume of work, the type of oven, the dimensions of the chamber and the client’s quality objectives.

Can bread quality be improved by better controlling fermentation?

Yes. When temperature and humidity are maintained steadily, fermentation develops more uniformly. This helps to improve the flavour, colour, preservation and consistency of the final product.

What advantages does clean steam provide in bakery ovens?

Clean steam improves the presentation of the bread, promotes shine and scoring, and prevents many problems caused by systems that dirty the steam generators or lose performance over time.

How do we know what equipment our bakery needs?

We only need to understand your process. With production data, oven type, chamber dimensions and service needs, our technicians calculate the most suitable power and configuration for your bakery.

SUCCESSFUL INSTALLATIONS ALL OVER THE WORLD
